articles.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
articles.abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
articles.titleCn: 阐明LM数据归因的设计空间
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型（LM）的数据归因方法通常通过下游任务（如事实检索）进行评估。然而，现有的评估同时改变了多个数据集属性，导致无法精确分离出归因算法失败的原因。为了诊断这些失败，我们探索了大型语言模型（LLM）数据归因的设计空间，重点关注评估方法。我们引入了用于事实追踪的受控归因基准（CATT），在该基准中，我们对LLM在完全虚构的知识上进行微调，从而为归因提供了明确的真值。这种合成设置使我们能够系统地每次改变一个数据集配置，例如文档冗余和词汇干扰项。通过这种可配置的评估，我们证明冗余和干扰项始终会降低归因性能。我们没有提出新的估计器，而是考察了两个尚未充分探索的设计选择：用于计算梯度的损失函数以及如何将每个token的归因分数聚合为文档分数。我们发现，训练文档中的真实因果证据高度局部化，但标准方法通过在整个文档中对归因分数进行平均，将这种证据稀释为噪声。我们发现，用负对数概率梯度替代标准交叉熵损失梯度，可以将关键token从其他无信息的token中分离出来。然后，我们仅聚合顶级token分数，在我们的诊断基准上，多个基线模型的真值召回率提高了35%到72个百分点。负对数概率校正也适用于FTRACE-TREX，通过这种方法，我们测试的每种方法的反事实再训练性能提高了高达4.9倍。

articles.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
articles.abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.
articles.titleCn: 浅层防御：利用浅层安全对齐实现多轮防御者
articles.abstractCn: 安全对齐使大型语言模型能够直接可靠地拒绝有害请求，但同样的请求在多轮对话中分布后仍然过于频繁地成功。这种脆弱性有机制根源：对齐是肤浅的，安全行为集中在模型的最初几个输出标记中，而现有的防御措施继承了这种弱点，仅监督响应的表面形式，从未给模型提供明确的安全决策来学习。我们持相反的浅层观点：如果短片段决定了整个响应的轨迹，那么这个片段就是干预的最高杠杆点，防御者可以首先占据它。我们提出了评估→决定→响应（Assess→Decide→Respond）框架，其中防御者评估用户的意图，承诺一个明确、可解析的安全决策，然后才根据该决策生成回复，该承诺在有效载荷轮次中通过强化学习进行训练。因为决策是一个标记片段，所以奖励可以是一个规则：自我验证的奖励检查承诺标签与对话的已知性质，无需裁判和标注，而相同的格式也支持在分级决策空间中通过安全重定向的LLM作为裁判的奖励。在涵盖安全、效用和有用性的两个模型系列和十四个基准测试中，我们的防御者在受控比较中实现了最强的多轮安全，在保持安全领先的同时，以对有用性只有适度影响为代价来保留效用。每标记KL分析和干预性探测证实了其工作原理：训练集中其效果于设定响应轨迹的简短审议，而在此处承诺的决策是一个因果控制点。攻击者利用的非常浅层性变成了防御机制。

articles.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
articles.abstract: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.
articles.titleCn: 来自时间线的证词：基于证据的时序临床假设显著性检验
articles.abstractCn: 询问语言模型产品召回后销量是否倾向于下降，或疫苗副作用是否倾向于相继出现，它都会用一句流畅的、看似研究发现的话来回答，背后却没有任何测试支撑。关于事件在多个案例中如何展开的断言充斥着网络，而每个断言都是一个时间假设，只有通过在正确的记录上进行显著性测试才能解决。验证者必须指定零假设，选择测试并决定哪些记录与假设相关，而即使这些选择出错，结论仍可能正确。然而，用于语言模型数据分析的基准测试只评估结论，相关的数据则被直接移交。我们在医疗领域研究这一问题，因为错误的裁决代价高昂，并提出了STRATA，一个在裁决过程中对每个决策进行评分的基准测试：8,735个假设跨越疫苗不良事件报告的临床时间线，其金标准、证据集、p值和裁决均基于已发布的代码簿推导，并由确定性预言机重现。我们还提出了ART（阐述、检索、测试）这一分阶段范式，将每个决策都暴露为可检查的输出。在五种模型配置上的大量实验表明，系统主要在决定哪些记录算数时失败，而准确率本身无法掩盖裁决与证据之间的差距。ART弥补了大部分这一差距，并将31B规模的开放模型在相同范式下提升至前沿模型的0.01附近；而前沿模型一旦获得代码簿即可成功。

articles.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
articles.abstract: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged. It also preserves output diversity and adds no measurable inference latency. Its predecessor, TextSeal, restores diversity in the Gumbel-max scheme by routing each token to one of two keys via a coin flip. This is suboptimal because the detector averages the scores from both keys without knowing which key was used. TextSeal2 instead merges two or more keys into a single virtual key and couples it to fresh noise through AutoMark's Gaussian copula. Any number of keys, including publicly shared keys, can be merged this way without diluting detection. Under speculative decoding, TextSeal2 verifies keyed drafts with one more exponential race, run on the leftovers of the draft races. By memorylessness, this race reproduces block verification, so the output follows the target model exactly. We evaluate TextSeal2 on three LLMs. At equal output token diversity, TextSeal2 detects 8 to 22 percentage points more 100-token answers than TextSeal at a false-positive rate of $10^{-3}$, and is comparable to textGrain while requiring no post-logits optimization. Under speculative decoding, it detects 18 and 22 percentage points more 200-token answers than TextSeal and textGrain, respectively, at the same acceptance rate.
articles.titleCn: TextSeal2：基于Copula混合和无记忆竞赛的无失真LLM水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了TextSeal2，一种适用于大型语言模型的免失真水印技术，它能在推测解码过程中保持其信号：替换被拒绝草稿的标记仍然使用相同的密钥进行水印，接受率保持不变。它还保留了输出多样性，且不增加可测量的推理延迟。其前身TextSeal通过抛硬币的方式将每个标记路由到两个密钥中的一个，以在Gumbel-max方案中恢复多样性。这是次优的，因为检测器在不知道使用了哪个密钥的情况下，对两个密钥的分数进行平均。TextSeal2则将两个或多个密钥合并为一个虚拟密钥，并通过AutoMark的高斯 Copula将其与新的噪声耦合。通过这种方式，任何数量的密钥，包括公开共享的密钥，都可以合并而不削弱检测效果。在推测解码过程中，TextSeal2通过在草稿比赛的剩余部分上运行一个额外的指数比赛来验证带密钥的草稿。根据无记忆性，这场比赛会重现块验证，因此输出完全符合目标模型。我们在三个大型语言模型上评估了TextSeal2。在相同的输出标记多样性下，TextSeal2在假阳性率为$10^{-3}$时，检测到的100标记答案比TextSeal多8到22个百分点，且与textGrain相当，同时无需后逻辑优化。在推测解码过程中，它在相同的接受率下，分别比TextSeal和textGrain多检测18和22个百分点的200标记答案。

articles.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
articles.abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables; supplementary material included (Sections S1-S8)
articles.titleCn: 何时协助以及建议什么：在单个紧凑解码器中进行联合门控和基于记忆的提示生成
articles.abstractCn: 主动助手在对话中提供基于记忆的简短提示，决定何时协助以及建议什么内容。当前系统将此功能分为一个门控模块和一个更大的生成器；我们在28058个决策点上同时评估了这两种方法。分阶段生成评分是或然门控的上限：在真实门控后，端到端精确匹配得分为0.2619，上限为0.2971，端到端精确度为0.2387，仍有较大提升空间。门控模块通过精确度和计算效率获得收益，其节省比例从使用8B生成器时的4.39倍降至使用1B生成器时的1.38倍。内存配置直接影响提示质量：移除内存会损失24.7个精确匹配分（重新缩放的BERTScore从0.57降至0.35），而检索和更大的生成器对精确匹配无任何提升。一个1B解码器可以同时执行门控和生成，在同一遍过程中从中间层获取门控信息并生成内容。在其最终检查点时，该模型在自动端到端指标上与双模型管道相当或更优，且比匹配的1B管道节省1.31-1.76倍的墙钟时间；在三个种子下，其更深的退出层与独立门控模块相当。人类评估（对32个对话的1144个评分）支持内存效应，并将单模型级别评分与匹配的1B管道相当，略低于8B管道。分级指标和LlamaPIE的原生判别器比精确匹配更紧密地追踪人类评分，我们将其报告为严格的下限。

articles.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
articles.abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
articles.titleCn: VeriCUA：为使用计算机的智能体设计的代理式验证探索
articles.abstractCn: 在桌面、移动和网页环境中构建和扩展使用计算机的智能体（CUAs）需要可靠的任务完成验证，用于数据管理、评估和强化学习。典型的自动化方法会提示视觉语言模型（VLMs）判断轨迹或生成程序来检查应用程序状态。然而，这两种方法都依赖于复杂数字环境的部分视图。VLM判断者仅限于提供的观察结果，而生成的程序则依赖于可访问的状态。这些视图可能会遗漏决定性证据，或使完成判断缺乏支持。针对不同平台和访问设置定制单独的验证器会增加额外的工程成本。我们提出了VeriCUA，一个平台无关的通过智能体探索进行验证的框架。它将验证视为在跨平台和观察模式的在线和离线设置中共享程序内的动态证据收集和评估。在检查可用上下文以构建任务标准后，验证器会选择GUI或代码检查来解决未满足的要求，并根据明确的证据规则结合它们的发现。实验表明，在这些设置中，与比较基线相比，VeriCUA在参考标签上具有更高的协议一致性，在离线设置中最大的收益体现在难案例子上，并且在线时对虚假完成声明的拒绝更为强烈。进一步的分析将这些收益与互补证据和测试时探索联系起来。

articles.title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
articles.abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.
articles.titleCn: 多视图MoE：让每个路由器塑造专家计算
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型通过每个token激活少量专家来扩展参数容量。专家选择直接影响在固定激活专家预算下的模型能力。对所有专家的密集评估揭示了单路由排序与专家效用评估排序之间在中间层和深层存在弱一致性。更丰富的选择和计算信号会带来额外成本：基于内部专家激活的选择需要预先计算，而通过同一专家分别处理多个完整表示会重复计算。我们提出多视图MoE，通过多个路由器改进专家选择，并在固定专家预算下复用其偏好来调节专家计算。其多路由器子模块聚合了独立初始化路由器产生的sigmoid分数。这些路由器在训练过程中发展出高度差异化的专家偏好，允许被单个路由器强烈偏好或被多个路由器联合支持的专家被选中。多视图进一步利用每个选中专家在不同路由器中的相对分数，将其学习到的潜在视图混合到输入中，复用路由偏好用于选择和计算。每个选中专家执行一次前向传递，保持激活专家数量、专家FLOPs和全连接通信量。在一个在708B tokens上训练的24层10B-A1B模型上，完整的Multi-View MoE比基线提升了1.18个百分点。仅多路由器模块可带来0.6个百分点的增益，并提高了路由器分数与评估专家效用之间的秩相关性，全局相对提升8.1%，在单路由器一致性最低的层中提升约58%。受控混合干预表明，模型利用了取决于专家和token的输入差异。

articles.title: PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

articles.titleCn: PIVOT：通过在线教师纠正实现的渐进式干预
articles.abstractCn: 从可验证奖励中进行强化学习（RLVR）在处理困难推理任务时受到稀疏结果级反馈的限制：当一组所有 rollout 都失败时，奖励无法提供学习信号。更强的教师可以提供额外指导，但这引发了一个核心问题：如何将这些信号融入 RLVR 以支持成功的 rollout，同时保持对学生的可学习性？我们区分了两种互补机制：轨迹级干预，它提高了获取带有奖励轨迹的途径；以及标记级监督，它为学生的学习提供密集目标。我们的受控实验表明，单独使用任何一种机制都可能不足，因此需要将它们结合起来。为此，我们引入了 PIVOT，它将教师生成的纠正插入到学生的 rollout 中，并在这些片段上应用标记级的 KL 监督，同时结合 RLVR 目标。除了它们的结合之外，我们还系统地分析了干预的位置和监督的方法，从而得出有效的指导方案。在困难逻辑游戏和数学推理基准测试中，PIVOT 始终优于现有方法，在逻辑游戏上平均 avg@8 几乎翻倍，从最佳基线的 19.5% 提升至 35.6%。

articles.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
articles.titleCn: 每个Token都需要自己的老师：多老师自适应在线策略自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于策略的自蒸馏（OPSD）通过构建一个基于特权参考的教师模型，已被证明对大型语言模型的后续训练有效。然而，现有方法要么在整个训练过程中始终让教师模型暴露于完整参考，要么在每个响应内通过自适应地变化部分参考暴露来固定教师模型。在本文中，我们论证这两种方法都不足以满足需求。相反，每个标记都需要它自己的教师，因为在同一响应中，教师模型的偏好可能因标记而异。通过一项教师干预初步研究，我们验证了教师模型的偏好在不同标记之间存在差异，并揭示可以通过多数投票和基于KL散度的选择为每个标记识别出偏好教师模型。基于这些发现，我们提出了多教师自适应基于策略自蒸馏（MTA-OPSD），这是首个标记级别的自适应OPSD方法。我们的方法构建了一个由候选教师模型组成的多教师池，并使每个标记在训练过程中能够自适应地选择其偏好的教师模型。在数学推理任务上使用Qwen3模型的实验表明，MTA-OPSD始终优于现有的OPSD方法，平均提升高达+5.9%，突显了在标记级别调整教师监督的重要性。代码可在https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD获取。

articles.title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
articles.abstract: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

articles.titleCn: 比较人类角色扮演者与LLM模拟客户在在线咨询培训中的作用：咨询模式分析
articles.abstractCn: 本研究旨在探究大型语言模型在模拟教育角色扮演中的来访者方面的能力，并与真人角色扮演者进行比较。最初，我们记录了新手咨询师与扮演来访者的真人同伴进行的角色扮演会话，随后进行了人类与由Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b使用4位量化模拟的来访者之间的角色扮演。这些互动通过咨询沟通模式系统在句子层面进行分析。我们研究了两个关键问题：(1) 大型语言模型生成的回应在多大程度上复制了真实的对话动态，以及(2) 咨询师在与真人来访者与大型语言模型模拟的来访者互动时，其沟通行为是否存在差异。研究结果表明，在不同场景中应用咨询模式时存在相似之处和差异，展示了基于大型语言模型的角色扮演练习在提升咨询能力以及识别虚拟来访者模拟中需要进一步改进的领域的潜力。

articles.title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
articles.abstract: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.
articles.titleCn: 拉马努金挑战赛结果：多格式证明的AI辅助评估流程
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能数学能力的快速提升，有意义的基准测试正从大学水平问题和数学奥林匹克竞赛转向研究级数学。拉马努金挑战赛是一个包含数论研究级问题的基准测试，其中包括未发表的成果和开放性猜想。它提供了数学常数的具体公式，这些公式的正确性可以通过数值方法检验，而其证明可能需要非显而易见的数学知识。在此，我们分析了挑战赛的提交内容，评估了不同人工智能模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）和形式工具的相对成功率。我们发现了一些在概念上与官方解法不同的正确提交，并证明了一个已发表的开放性猜想。评估提交内容揭示了一个新的挑战：在规模化条件下可靠地评判复杂证明。我们引入了一种人工智能辅助的评估流程，用于自然语言证明、CAS代码和Lean形式化，该流程评估语义和逻辑正确性。与传统的单次大型语言模型（LLM）评判相比，我们的流程将自然语言证明的假阳性判定率从23%降至6%，并将支持代码的评判准确率从46%提高到58%。这种方法为大规模评估研究级数学提供了一种方法论，在数学和人工智能科学领域具有潜在应用价值。

articles.title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
articles.abstract: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. The per-step stopping probability of a response is not constant but ramps up over hundreds of steps, so the decode length inherits a central limit theorem from the many local decisions that determine where a response ends; this yields per-prompt normality with an explicit error term, together with an affine variance law $σ=αμ+b$ whose slope is the coefficient of variation of the number of response segments. Empirically, the normal law reproduces the per-prompt MAE and the central mass of the decode-length distribution to within a few percent, and the residual departures from normality (mild right skew, slight excess kurtosis) are the ones predicted by the sampling-noise correction. Under fixed model, data, and sampling conditions, a broad design space of predictors (MLP, EGTP, FiLM, soft-label, and Mixture-of-Experts variants) converges to similar performance close to the bound, confirming that \emph{system error dominates model error}. We argue for a benchmarking protocol that fixes the model, data, and sampling parameters and that reports relative-error metrics alongside absolute ones. Code and analysis tools are available at https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict.
articles.titleCn: 基于预填充的解码长度预测的基本限制
articles.abstractCn: 仅使用预填充阶段隐藏状态来预测大型语言模型（LLM）将解码多少个token，是推理调度中的一个关键基础。我们证明当前的基准测试将预测器质量与任务难度混淆：当目标模型、数据集或采样配置发生变化时，即使预测器保持不变，报告的准确率也会崩溃。我们将这种不稳定性追溯到被忽视的错误来源——自回归解码的固有随机性，并推导出所有预填充侧方法必须遵守的界限。我们的分析将解码视为一个停止的随机过程。响应的每一步停止概率并非恒定不变，而是随数百步逐渐增加，因此解码长度继承了决定响应结束位置的大量局部决策所产生的中心极限定理；这产生了具有明确误差项的每条提示的正态性，以及斜率为响应段数量变异系数的仿射方差定律 $σ=αμ+b$。实证上，正态定律在每条提示的MAE和解码长度分布的中央质量方面与实际值相差几个百分点，而正态性的残余偏差（轻微的右偏、轻微的峰度过剩）正是采样噪声校正所预测的。在固定的模型、数据和采样条件下，各种预测器（MLP、EGTP、FiLM、软标签和专家混合体变体）的设计空间都趋近于相似的、接近界限的性能，证实了 \emph{系统误差主导模型误差}。我们主张采用一种固定模型、数据和采样参数的基准测试协议，并伴随报告相对误差指标和绝对误差指标。代码和分析工具可在 https://github.com/ShwStone/DecodingPredict 获得。

articles.title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
articles.abstract: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

articles.titleCn: 家庭自制的SLM：为葡萄牙语在家构建的自回归和掩码扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 自己构建语言模型不再需要数据中心。本教程从头开始训练模型，包括分词器，在单个消费级GPU上进行，并展示如何判断其是否适用于专业领域任务。本教程未提出新方法。它发布了一个经过测试的Python包和两个葡萄牙语（巴西）的笔记本，包含单网络上的自回归和掩码扩散生成，一个预先注册的比较协议，仅从文本构建的法律任务，带有Kneser-Ney下限和公共基准，11至12M参数模型的参考编号，以及仅通过测量发现的缺陷目录。在巴西散文和联邦法律上，每分钟运行，自回归模式在相同文本上达到64个epoch后开始记忆，而掩码扩散可提升至256。在测试的最佳点，扩散界限超过自回归似然0.06比特/字节，在预先注册的最小效应范围内。在保留的法律和训练后发布的法令上，模型在相同窗口上似然与6-gram下限持平，但在继续这些法令时逊于下限。它在检测篡改文本方面胜过下限，并且比160M和630M参数的下限和公共模型更频繁地填充交叉引用，仅在法令中，这一训练中缺失的体裁中，这些评分者保持在或低于机会水平，并且仅在每组权重相同时才填充空白，因为每项它与630M模型持平。在法律上，公共模型使用约5×10^2至10^5倍的算力训练，在篡改文本和延续方面领先。盲法人工阅读已预先注册，但不包含在此版本中。

articles.title: IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
articles.abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.
articles.titleCn: IndicIPR-QA：印度知识产权法上的抽取式问答基准
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言处理（NLP）领域，针对法规文本的法律问题回答是一项具有挑战性的任务，特别是在法律体系复杂的低资源环境中。这项任务要求回答必须精确且基于法律依据。然而，据目前所知，尚无现有的抽取式问答基准能够从所有七部印度知识产权（IPR）法案的法规文本中提供确切的答案片段。本文介绍了IndicIPR-QA1，这是一个针对印度知识产权法律的抽取式问答基准。该数据集包含来自七部法案中1,116个法规上下文的4,462个问答对。问题和答案通过GPT-4o生成，并通过九项自动质量检查、单模型和多模型的大型语言模型（LLM）评估以及200对的人工审核进行验证。章节级别的划分防止了训练集、验证集和测试集之间源上下文的重叠。进一步的分析考察了语料库和各个法案中答案片段的长度、词汇重叠和多子句结构。BM25在token级别的F1得分达到20.21，而微调后的InLegalBERT在统一的滑动窗口推理协议下达到了85.02。BM25（20.21 F1）和InLegalBERT（85.02 F1）之间巨大的性能差距表明，简单的词语匹配不足以回答这些法律问题。性能在七部法案之间也存在差异，表明在答案提取性能上存在显著不同。

articles.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
articles.abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.
articles.titleCn: 如何校准您的模型：使用模板扩展多语言安全培训
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的安全对齐工作高度集中于英语，多语言代表性有限，尤其损害低资源语言的表现。相关的开放训练数据集往往规模有限，或未遵循区域本地化的有害话题，从而限制了安全对齐范围的文化多样性。我们提出了一种可扩展的基于模板的增强流程，用于生成大规模的多语言拒绝语料和良性语料，从有害提示中提取安全模板，翻译后用文化本地的实体填充插槽，涵盖有害和良性内容。为此，我们发布了MSafeTemp，一个涵盖60种语言的验证语料库，适用于多语言安全对齐和评估。利用该数据集，我们证明仅英语评估会误判多语言安全：对于某些模型，在英语中失败的攻击一旦翻译后即可成功，而文化本地化的变体则暴露了翻译本身遗漏的进一步问题。我们还确认，通过模板增强安全训练数据可以提高对齐的多样性和质量，从而在英语之外提升安全性能。MSafeTemp及其相应流程旨在促进对代表性不足文化的更安全、更负责任模型的研究与开发。

articles.title: A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment
articles.titleCn: 一个低秩空间捕捉了在自然语言聆听过程中LLM与人类神经活动之间的线性对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作人类语言处理过程的计算模型，然而，它们表征中的哪些组件驱动了与神经活动的对齐尚不清楚。在此，我们使用岭降维回归来识别LLM表征的脑预测子空间：支持神经反应线性预测的表征方向。在跨越脑电图和fMRI的三个自然语言听力数据集，以及自回归、双向掩码和随机初始化语言模型的六个模型条件下，我们发现仅使用1-3%的原始嵌入维度即可恢复完整的线性编码性能。这些低维子空间在保留参与者之外的数据集上具有泛化能力，并在一定程度上跨越数据集，表明神经预测性集中在紧凑且部分共享的表征空间中。接下来，我们将这些脑预测方向与嵌入变化的主轴进行比较。主成分分析需要更多的维度才能恢复神经预测，这表明用于预测神经活动的方向与捕捉LLM表征中最大总体方差的方向是不同的。最后，通过表征子空间的特征化，我们能够揭示在神经活动中过表达的、超越LLM表征的可解释特征。总的来说，这些结果表明LLM-大脑对齐是由模型表征的一个小而结构化的子集支持的，并提供了一个框架来更好地理解这些表征为何会与大脑对齐。代码可以在以下链接找到：https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment

articles.title: Discovering Interpretable Acoustic Features in Autoregressive Voice-Cloning TTS Models
articles.abstract: Voice-cloning TTS models synthesize an unseen speaker's voice from brief speech prompts, but it remains unclear which acoustic properties they represent and use. We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models, analyzing features from sparse autoencoders (SAEs), PCA, and random directions via sparse probing, steering, and quantitative auto-interpretability. We focus on Qwen3-TTS and extend probing and steering to $5$ additional models to test generalization across architectures. These models encode concepts like pitch, energy, noise, and accent, but sparse prediction and steering are effective only for some concepts. Strong probing does not always translate to steering or vice-versa. SAEs are useful for sparse probing of human-labelled concepts and novel-concept discovery, while PCA is competitive for dense probing and steering. Auto-interpretability finds $684$ automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS covering speaker clusters, speaking style, and recording conditions beyond known concepts. Overall, we perform a comprehensive interpretability study of autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models.
articles.titleCn: 在自回归语音克隆TTS模型中发现可解释的声学特征
articles.abstractCn: 声音克隆TTS模型能够根据简短的语音提示合成未见过的人的语音，但其代表和使用的声学特性仍不明确。我们引入了一种基于特征的解释性框架，用于自回归声音克隆TTS模型，通过稀疏探测、引导和定量自动解释性分析稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）、主成分分析（PCA）和随机方向的特征。我们重点关注Qwen3-TTS，并将探测和引导扩展到另外5个模型，以测试跨架构的泛化能力。这些模型编码了诸如音调、能量、噪声和口音等概念，但稀疏预测和引导仅对某些概念有效。强探测并不总是转化为引导或反之亦然。SAEs适用于人类标记概念的稀疏探测和新型概念发现，而PCA在密集探测和引导方面具有竞争力。自动解释性在Qwen3-TTS中发现了684个自动验证的SAE特征，涵盖了说话人集群、说话风格和录音条件等已知概念之外的内容。总体而言，我们对自回归声音克隆TTS模型进行了全面的解释性研究。

articles.title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.
articles.titleCn: 代理式大学：个性化学习的协作代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型支持个性化辅导、内容生成和自适应学习路径。然而，能力发展需要这些资源和交互形成一个与学习者共同进化的学习过程。一个核心挑战是在使用学习证据决定后续内容时，协调目标、活动和评估。我们引入了人参与的多智能体组织，并在代理大学（AU）中实例化它。在AU中，学习者作为组织成员参与，并与专业代理合作维护一个可修订的能力计划。该计划连接个人目标、跨模态的学习活动以及分层评估，而学习者的反馈和表现指导后续支持。我们的评估显示在计划组织、评估设计和修订质量方面具有优势。用户实现了更大的平均评估提升（在50分制中为12.19分对比5.61分），并报告了更强的认知支持。这项工作为自适应学习提供了一种组织方法，使学习者参与成为多智能体协调的持续基础。代理大学项目可在 \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git} 获取。

articles.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
articles.abstract: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.
articles.comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste
articles.titleCn: rTaste：研究代理是否具有品味？评估早期研究判断
articles.abstractCn: 研究代理是否具备品味，即在实验结果未知之前判断哪些实验值得运行？我们向六个前沿模型提供了七篇最新的自然语言处理论文。每个模型单独或作为团队工作时，都提出了最小可行实验（MVE），预测每个实验能否通过其设定的阈值，并对它们进行排序。随后，一个独立的执行者尝试所有MVE，包括排名最后的实验，而三个模型审计员则评判结果。在415个MVE中，194个被评判为合理、有价值且新颖，但其中不到一半（73个）还被评判为超越了种子论文且非显而易见。代理的首选实验与审计员最看重的实验匹配度高于随机选择，但并未证明优于首先写出的实验。它们的预测优于基准率，但与仅获得论文和注册信息的相同模型的新实例的预测相比，并未显示出更高的准确性。团队的成本更高，且在提案质量上没有明显的整体改进。代理产出了许多有价值的实验，但它们排名改善运行选择实验的证据仍然有限。评估框架和包含所有415个MVE及其预测和审计结果的数据库可在https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste获取。

articles.title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
articles.abstract: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.
articles.titleCn: 通过正交投影在持续LLM去学习过程中保留效用
articles.abstractCn: 去学习涉及从模型中移除训练数据中敏感部分的影响，例如受保护、版权或私人文本，而无需从头开始重新训练模型。虽然去学习请求在模型的生命周期中持续发生，但绝大多数大型语言模型（LLM）去学习方法都不适用于迭代移除，导致在连续去学习过程中遗忘和效用急剧下降。这种衰减源于连续更新之间的干扰，因为每次新的删除都可能撤销之前的删除或使模型进一步沿着已经被它们恶化的方向发展。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了持续正交投影（COP），这是一种梯度投影方案，它将每次更新限制在先前遗忘集中缓存的激活子空间的正交补空间中。这种方法可证明在早期删除之间不会产生一阶干扰。COP每个层仅存储低秩基，无需过去的梯度或之前的遗忘集，并且可以嵌入到通过在可微分的损失上进行梯度步长更新模型而去学习的方法中，而无需修改其目标。在标准LLM去学习基准（TOFU和RWKU）上的实验表明，COP在连续请求中保持效用而不削弱遗忘，防止了标准目标的崩溃，并且比持续特定的基线更有效地实现了遗忘。

articles.title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
articles.abstract: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.
articles.comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF 2026 (non-archival)
articles.titleCn: FIRME：用于演化异构投资者知识的注册锚定内存图谱
articles.abstractCn: 需要复用投资者知识的金融AI工作流需要持久化内存，这种内存能够在不丢失身份或来源的情况下整合跨来源和跨时期的观察结果。在知识图谱中，重复出现的观察结果可能使用不同的表面形式，导致关系历史碎片化，并阻碍证据的积累。我们介绍了融合与身份注册以实现记忆进化（FIRME），这是一种以注册为中心的记忆图谱，它将传入的观察结果与持久化的规范关系进行协调，并保留其来源、时间和上下文。在时期内，基于规则的融合将投资者电话讨论与投资组合现金流信号链接起来，直接链接或通过固定的产品-主题本体链接。跨时期，规范身份和持久别名将重复出现的观察结果导向相同的关系历史；确定性更新总结了强化、不活动和重新激活。我们在专有的投资者电话和现金流记录以及标普500盈利电话记录上评估了FIRME。与保留规范身份和语义回退但省略别名记忆的历史注册相比，在固定裁判和回退审查协议下，FIRME在四个数据集-后端设置中使最终时期的正确匹配率提高了7.8-12.1个百分点。每个设置中200个传入观察结果的盲法人工审计发现，正确匹配率提高了9.0-16.5点，重新附着召回率提高了22.5-29.0点，所有四个样本中观察到更高的合并精度。单独的审计发现，在投资者电话设置中，完整时期融合的300个输出中有293个具有有效的证据路径。提取忠实度和往返诊断评估了来源接地和提取器派生图谱内容的保留。

articles.title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
articles.abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
articles.comment: 76 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables (27 pages main text, 7 main figures, 2 main tables)
articles.titleCn: 在模拟环境中训练精神病学问诊语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 在精神病学实践中，临床摄入访谈仍然是主要的诊断工具，要求临床医生在建立融洽关系的同时，理清复杂且重叠的临床表现。在此，我们展示在模拟环境中进行多轮强化学习（RL）能够提升语言模型在结构化文本形式的精神病学摄入中的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初步管理计划。在一项随机双盲交叉研究中（60对匹配场景，120次会面），比较了经过RL训练的智能体与其相同提示的基础模型，32名认证精神科医生扮演标准化患者，而另一组15名独立的认证精神科医生对去识别化的访谈记录进行评分。训练后的智能体在76.7%的匹配场景对中表现优于基础模型（p < 0.0001），在改编的临床检查评分标准（d_z = 0.77，p < 0.0001）、以患者为中心的沟通（82.0% vs. 65.2%，p < 0.001）和鉴别诊断的适当性（68.3% vs. 33.3%，p < 0.001）方面均有提升。在127名精神科医生验证的模拟摄入场景中，训练后的智能体的临床评分标准得分几乎是基础模型的两倍（0.706 vs. 0.379；综合奖励0.564 vs. 0.294，p < 0.0001）。为了系统地探究对话安全，我们建立了两个德尔菲共识分类法，涵盖临床安全风险和关系能力，从中衍生出256个具有挑战性的对抗性表现；我们发现，在模拟环境中进行训练将急性安全风险低估率降低了一半以上（12.9% vs. 30.5%，p < 0.0001）。模拟环境因此为训练和压力测试精神病学对话智能体提供了受控的测试平台，其提升效果可迁移至精神科医生实施的会面，尽管残余差距需要安全措施和临床医生监督。

articles.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Adapters and code: https://huggingface.co/airun-ai/GlanceRAG-MiMo-9B-Reranker
articles.titleCn: 一瞥：生成器即为其自身的重排序器
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成通常使用独立的模型进行重新排序和回答，导致模型驻留和段落处理重复。我们引入了Glance，它为生成器配备了轻量级决策适配器和指针头，用于从共享预填充中评分候选段落。短相关性探针从缓存上下文中分支出来，为每个段落生成一个分数，而无需单独预填充每个查询-段落对。单个9B骨干网络支持生成、通用决策和重新排序，每个决策技能约增加0.1 GiB的额外内存。经过39分钟的MS MARCO微调后，Glance在SciFact上实现了0.741的nDCG@10，在NFCorpus上实现了0.345，而bge-reranker-v2-m3分别为0.721和0.326。在300个HotpotQA问题上，与相同基础生成器下交叉编码器选择的上下文相比，其选择的上下文使答案F1提高了0.045（配对自举95% CI [0.014, 0.076]）。在扩展研究中，重新排序质量在从一个共享预填充中评分高达200个候选（43k个token）时持续提升，此时其nDCG@10超过了交叉编码器0.058，并且一个仅激活探针的适配器允许生成从原始段落缓存继续。这些初步结果表明了基于生成器的重新排序，当前评估涵盖两个检索数据集、一个问答数据集和一个骨干网络家族。

articles.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
articles.abstract: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents. The protocol measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable under tool schemas, state preconditions, and data dependencies, and summarizes reliability using Prefix Executability Curves (PEC), First-Error Depth (FED), Trajectory Executability Rate (TER), horizon-normalized AUC-PEC, and Recovery Rate (RR). We instantiate the protocol on stratified samples from BFCL-v3 multi-turn and ToolSandbox, and on the complete Airline/Retail base splits of $τ^3$-bench. We observe that outcome-only and prefix-level rankings diverge: agents whose execution is conditioned on an unverified plan often achieve higher point-estimate final success than non-plan-conditioned baselines while substantially lowering TER and AUC-PEC. These divergences are precisely the failure modes that prefix executability is designed to expose: they reveal whether apparent success rests on an executable trajectory, where invalidity first enters, and whether success follows recovery from an earlier failure. As a validation intervention, explicit pre-execution plan checking can improve executable-prefix survival while maintaining competitive terminal success. These results show that final success alone is insufficient for evaluating tool-use agents and that prefix-level executability provides an actionable reliability signal for comparing agents, diagnosing failures, and assessing validation mechanisms.
articles.titleCn: 前缀可执行性：超越最终成功评估使用工具的智能体
articles.abstractCn: 工具使用基准测试通常通过最终任务成功来评估智能体，但终端结果可能会掩盖中间工具调用轨迹是否可执行的问题。我们提出将前缀可执行性作为工具使用智能体的轨迹级评估协议。该协议测量预测的工具调用序列的每个前缀在工具模式、状态先决条件和数据依赖下是否保持可执行性，并使用前缀可执行性曲线（PEC）、首次错误深度（FED）、轨迹可执行率（TER）、视野标准化AUC-PEC和恢复率（RR）来总结可靠性。我们在BFCL-v3多轮和ToolSandbox的分层样本以及τ^3-bench的完整航空/零售基础拆分上实例化该协议。我们观察到结果仅和前缀级排名存在分歧：依赖于未经验证的计划执行的智能体往往比非计划依赖基线获得更高的点估计最终成功率，但显著降低了TER和AUC-PEC。这些分歧恰恰是前缀可执行性旨在暴露的失败模式：它们揭示了表面成功是否基于可执行的轨迹、无效性首次进入的位置，以及成功是否是在早期失败后恢复的结果。作为一种验证干预措施，显式的前执行计划检查可以在保持竞争性终端成功率的同时提高可执行前缀的存活率。这些结果表明，仅凭最终成功不足以评估工具使用智能体，而前缀级可执行性为比较智能体、诊断故障和评估验证机制提供了可操作的可靠性信号。

articles.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
articles.abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
articles.titleCn: 从结构化教科书扩展数学证明监督
articles.abstractCn: 数学语言模型的监督通常被扁平化为孤立的题目-解答对，从而丢弃了原始资料的课程组织和证据结构。我们引入了TOME-Math（面向教科书的数学证据），这是一个大规模语料库，将涵盖大学数学核心领域的2,118本教科书转化为约380K个结构化的证明监督记录，同时保留了章节顺序、命题-证明链接、依赖参考和来源出处。利用这些结构化信号，我们探索了跨多个数学学科的课程学习，并分析了监督量与来源广度对规模扩展模式的影响。在完整规模下，基于TOME-Math的微调使我们在保留的评估和已建立的公共基准测试中的未加权平均得分比基础模型提高了16.7个百分点，同时超越了综合评估的三个公共指令数据基线。我们的研究结果表明，结构化教科书既是可扩展的数学监督来源，也是研究数据组织对数学推理影响的实证框架。我们将发布该语料库以促进对结构化数学监督的进一步研究。

articles.title: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.
articles.comment: 18 pages main text plus 40 pages Supplementary Information
articles.titleCn: 基于多模态医疗记录的儿童糖尿病预后预测中的自主大型语言模型推理
articles.abstractCn: 针对临床预测提出了大型语言模型（LLM）代理，但在儿科领域尚未经过测试，因为儿科队列规模小且结果不常见。我们使用来自2,489名2型糖尿病（T2D）青少年和4,018名1型糖尿病（T1D）青少年的记录，涵盖结构化数据、基于记录的社会决定因素，以及在T1D中连续血糖监测数据，从18个月的随访中预测了24个月时的七个T2D结果，其中四个也适用于T1D。CEDAR（基于临床证据的风险预测代理）是一个引用证据、自我审计的LLM流程，在两个队列中都优于训练好的机器学习模型（合并受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.815，与T2D的0.656至0.700和T1D的0.756与0.603至0.631相比），尤其是在筛选稀疏的结果上表现最佳。它在引用的70,246个值中，只有4个与病历不符。仅阅读CEDAR引用的证据和推理，两位小儿内分泌学家在约九成情况下达到了与CEDAR相同的预测结果，他们之间的一致性达到了90.5%。

articles.title: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
articles.abstract: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.
articles.comment: Accepted at COLM 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/CORAL
articles.titleCn: 不要丢失线索：通过认知资源自我分配赋能长时程大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在解决复杂推理任务方面取得了显著进展。然而，由于工作记忆因不断扩展和不相关信息而变得杂乱，导致认知过载，LLM智能体在长时程任务上往往表现不佳，这会分散其注意力，阻碍有效的规划和推理。为应对这一挑战，我们引入认知资源自分配（CORAL）这一新型推理范式，赋予智能体主动优化其上下文的能力。作为可被智能体调用的工作记忆管理工具集，CORAL允许智能体检查点其任务进度和已验证的事实，通过重置杂乱上下文同时保留检查点信息，自适应地启动新的问题解决阶段，使其能从干净的状态恢复推理。我们进一步采用多阶段智能体强化策略优化算法增强智能体的检查点功能。在GAIA基准测试中，CORAL配合8B模型实现了42.8%的平均准确率，尤其是在最具挑战性的长时程任务（Level 2和Level 3）上取得了显著提升。关键在于，这些提升以大幅降低的推理成本实现：CORAL消耗的输入token数量仅为ReAct智能体的1/6至1/7。此外，CORAL还泛化到多跳知识问答基准测试以及难度显著更高的BrowseComp，其中它将一个强大的专有智能体的表现提升了8.0分。

articles.title: Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.
articles.titleCn: 预训练语言模型中并发时序变量的分解表示
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常需要在文档内维护多个独立演变的上下文变量。以往研究已经识别出单个时间或上下文量的结构化表示，但它们联合组织的机制仍不清楚。我们通过使用具有独立分阶段的语言切换和主题变化计时器的受控文档来研究这一问题。在十个预训练检查点中，两个计时器都可以从相同的隐藏状态中线性解码。移除与计时器相关的质心平面会显著减少对其关联变量的访问，而对同时存在的计时器影响很小，尽管这些平面是非正交的，并且包含跨计时器的信息。单独计时器的贡献也能解释联合状态质心的大部分可重复变化。这些特征在3到51个计时器值之间以及从0.6B到14B的Qwen3检查点中都持续存在。调度位置会影响延续概率，但测试的质心位移不会产生一致的计时器特定输出效果。综合这些结果，支持基于选择性可访问性和重叠子空间中近似加性的联合状态几何的近似分解。

articles.title: Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes
articles.abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. The primary outcome was accuracy; secondary outcomes included calibration, discrimination, accuracy of answers with probability >=0.90 and language differences. Results: In RheumaMIR, Jev's accuracy was 93.0% in Spanish and 91.9% in English, below GPT-6 Sol (99.4%; Holm-adjusted P<=0.005); GPT-6 Luna reached 97.7%, Clef 91.9-93.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%, without detectable language differences. Jev's answers with probability >=0.90 (76-77% of answers) were 98.5% correct. In RheumBench, accuracy was lower: GPT-6 Sol 76.9%, GPT-6 Luna 63.5%, Clef 59.6%, Jev 50.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4% (each System One model below GPT-6 Sol, Holm-adjusted P<=0.045; chance 9.6%). Jev became overconfident (mean probability 0.659; over/underconfidence index +0.159), and its answers with probability >=0.90 (25% of cases) were 84.6% correct, against 95.5% for GPT-6 Luna (42%). Laya performed near chance in both benchmarks. Conclusion: The best-performing System One models were highly accurate on examination questions but less accurate on diagnostic vignettes, remaining below GPT-6 Sol. Jev's high-confidence predictions were less reliable on vignettes, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation and calibration.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables; includes supplementary material (8 tables, 1 figure)
articles.titleCn: 风湿病学中的决策与系统一模型：在专科培训考试问题和诊断案例摘要中的准确性和校准
articles.abstractCn: 目标：评估决策与系统一模型在风湿病学考试问题和诊断情景中的准确性和校准度。方法：分析了两个基准：西班牙语和英语的西班牙风湿病学专业培训考试中的172个问题（扩展的RheumaMIR数据集），以及包含5-18个候选诊断（其中52个包含参考诊断）的70个英语RheumBench诊断情景。比较了四个系统一模型（Jev 1.13、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、Laya）与GPT-6 Luna（OpenAI决策API）以及GPT-6 Sol和两个本地生成模型。主要结果为准确率；次要结果包括校准度、区分度、概率≥0.90的答案准确率以及语言差异。结果：在RheumaMIR中，Jev的准确率在西班牙语中为93.0%，英语中为91.9%，低于GPT-6 Sol（99.4%；Holm调整P≤0.005）；GPT-6 Luna达到97.7%，Clef为91.9-93.0%，Microsoft-Decision-1为86.0-87.8%，未发现可检测的语言差异。Jev概率≥0.90的答案（占答案的76-77%）正确率为98.5%。在RheumBench中，准确率较低：GPT-6 Sol为76.9%，GPT-6 Luna为63.5%，Clef为59.6%，Jev为50.0%，Microsoft-Decision-1为40.4%（每个系统一模型均低于GPT-6 Sol，Holm调整P≤0.045；偶然概率为9.6%）。Jev变得过度自信（平均概率0.659；过度/不足自信指数+0.159），其概率≥0.90的答案（占25%的情况）正确率为84.6%，而GPT-6 Luna为95.5%（占42%）。Laya在两个基准中的表现接近偶然。结论：表现最佳的系统一模型在考试问题上的准确率很高，但在诊断情景中的准确率较低，仍低于GPT-6 Sol。Jev的高置信度预测在情景中的可靠性较低，突出了任务特定评估和校准的必要性。

articles.title: Leveraging Recourse and Size Bounds for OnlineKnapsack with Removable Items
articles.abstract: In the online unweighted knapsack problem, items arrive sequentially and must be accepted or rejected immediately for a bounded-capacity knapsack, aiming to maximize the total size of accepted items. When decisions are irrevocable, no algorithm achieves a non-trivial competitive ratio. An essential relaxation that circumvents this impossibility is to allow previously accepted items to be removed from the knapsack (a.k.a. removal). In this work, we investigate possible further improvements on the competitive ratio with removal by bringing together two other previously proposed model extensions: knowledge of an upper bound on the item sizes (a.k.a. bound awareness) and ability to reinsert previously rejected items(a.k.a.recourse). Our contributions are twofold. First, we establish close upper and lower bounds on the competitive ratio under bound awareness, removal and recourse. We show that significant improvements on the best known competitive ratio are possible when the upper bound on the item sizes is not too restrictive and only few uses of recourse are available. Second, we introduce the notion of adaptive online algorithms which do not require to know any upper bound on the item sizes but still achieve performance guarantees comparable to the ones obtained under the bound awareness model.
articles.titleCn: 利用资源约束和大小界限解决带可移除物品的在线背包问题
articles.abstractCn: 在线无权背包问题中，物品按顺序到达，必须立即决定接受或拒绝，以使有界容量的背包中接受物品的总大小最大化。当决策不可撤销时，没有算法能实现非平凡的竞争比。一个重要的放宽条件，可以绕过这种不可能性，是允许先前接受的物品从背包中移除（简称移除）。在这项工作中，我们通过结合另外两种先前提出的模型扩展——物品大小的上限知识（简称界限意识）和重新插入先前拒绝物品的能力（简称回溯），来研究移除条件下竞争比的进一步改进。我们的贡献有两个方面。首先，我们在界限意识、移除和回溯的条件下，建立了竞争比的上限和下限。我们表明，当物品大小的上限不是过于严格且回溯的使用次数很少时，可以显著提高已知的最佳竞争比。其次，我们引入了自适应在线算法的概念，这种算法不需要知道物品大小的任何上限，但仍然能实现与界限意识模型下获得的性能保证相当的保证。

articles.title: Latent Path Exploration via Potential-Guided Subtrajectory Balance
articles.abstract: Continuous latent reasoning enables language models to perform intermediate computation without generating explicit reasoning traces. Advances in stochastic latent reasoning allow multiple paths to be sampled in continuous space, but stochasticity alone does not ensure effective exploration. A key challenge is guiding stochastic transitions between intermediate latent states toward useful reasoning paths. We introduce SubLAT, which couples a relative answer potential with Subtrajectory Balance to learn stochastic latent exploration. The relative potential evaluates the answer support of sampled states against replacement states, with a correctness signal at the terminal state. Subtrajectory Balance relates potential differences to forward and backward transition densities across subtrajectories of different lengths. The model is jointly trained with answer supervision, CoT supervision, and representation distillation. Experiments on arithmetic and deductive reasoning show increasing solution coverage with larger sampling budgets across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, as well as improvements on several structural OOD benchmarks. Trajectory analyses reveal progressive divergence among sampled latent paths and higher mean relative potentials for correct trajectories across arithmetic benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 基于势能引导的子轨迹平衡进行潜在路径探索
articles.abstractCn: 连续潜推理使语言模型能够在不生成明确推理轨迹的情况下执行中间计算。随机潜推理的进步允许在连续空间中采样多条路径，但随机性本身并不能保证有效的探索。一个关键挑战是引导随机过渡，使中间潜状态之间的转换朝向有用的推理路径。我们引入了SubLAT，它结合了相对答案潜力和Subtrajectory Balance来学习随机潜探索。相对潜力评估采样状态相对于替换状态的答案支持度，并在终端状态提供正确性信号。Subtrajectory Balance将潜力差异与不同长度的子轨迹之间的正向和反向转换密度相关联。该模型与答案监督、CoT监督和表示蒸馏联合训练。在算术和演绎推理上的实验表明，随着采样预算的增加，在领域内和领域外基准测试中，解决方案覆盖率不断提高，并在多个结构化领域外基准测试中取得改进。轨迹分析揭示了采样潜路径之间的渐进式分化，以及算术基准测试中正确轨迹的平均相对潜力更高。

articles.title: Neighborhood Elites: Quality-Diversity Search for Uncertainty Quantification in Question Answering
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, yet they produce wrong answers indistinguishable from correct ones. In question answering (QA), such an error propagates unnoticed into downstream tasks. Perturbation-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) addresses this by probing a model over a set of input rewrites and reading uncertainty from how much its predictions vary. Yet this set is usually built generically, by free paraphrasing, token-level perturbation, or adversarial search. Such rewrites leave two things uncontrolled that matter in QA: what kind of change is made to the context, and how explicitly the context supports the answer. When neither is controlled, the composition of the set is determined by the generator rather than by design, and the estimate inherits whatever that generator happens to produce. Quality-diversity (QD) search is built to cover a predefined exploration space, so we recast input perturbation as a QD problem and propose \emph{neighborhood elites (NE)}, a neighborhood constructor that spreads answer-preserving rewrites across two axes, the kind of edit and the explicitness of support. We compare NE against three other neighborhood constructors, holding the editor, QA model, uncertainty measure and search objective fixed, and against three scores read from the original context. Across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs, NE improves failure detection against every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset-model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. Additionally, NE detects failure better than semantic entropy computed over decoder samples, by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, and this advantage widens as the neighborhood grows.
articles.titleCn: 社区精英：问答中不确定性量化的质量多样性搜索
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的能力日益增强，但它们产生的错误答案与正确答案无法区分。在问答（QA）任务中，这种错误会悄无声息地传播到下游任务中。基于扰动的模糊性量化（UQ）通过在一系列输入改写上探测模型，并从其预测变化程度中读取模糊性来解决这个问题。然而，这个集合通常是泛化构建的，通过自由释义、标记级扰动或对抗性搜索。这样的改写留下了两个在QA中重要的不可控因素：对上下文进行的更改类型，以及上下文对答案提供的明确程度。当两者都不受控制时，集合的组成由生成器决定而非设计，估计结果继承了生成器碰巧产生的任何结果。质量多样性（QD）搜索旨在覆盖预定义的探索空间，因此我们将输入扰动重新定义为QD问题，并提出\emph{邻域精英（NE）}，这是一种邻域构造器，它将答案保留的改写在两个轴上传播，即编辑类型和支撑的明确性。我们将NE与另外三种邻域构造器进行比较，保持编辑器、QA模型、模糊性度量以及搜索目标不变，并与从原始上下文中读取的三个分数进行比较。在五个抽取式-QA数据集和五个指令微调LLM上，NE在至少25个数据集-模型对中的每一个都改进了对其他构造器的失效检测，达到0.726 AUROC和0.211 AUPRC的提升。此外，NE在失效检测方面优于解码器样本上的语义熵，提升了0.074 AUROC和0.062 AUPRC，并且随着邻域的增长，这种优势会扩大。

articles.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
articles.abstract: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial checklists rather than compelling joint reasoning, and verifying these subtle interactions risks overlooking hidden flaws or rejecting valid alternatives. To address these challenges, we introduce CodeSpecWeave, a framework for synthesizing tasks with rich, interdependent specifications. Grounded in real developer seeds, a synthesis agent iteratively develops both coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to guarantee test reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct 4,670 training tasks across 2,865 repositories. Applying Reinforcement learning on these tasks significantly improves performance over the base model on DeepSWE-v1.1, largely outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we curate CodeSpecWeave-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 100 tasks and 1,044 specifications, which clearly separates frontier models and reveals significant headroom in handling interdependent engineering constraints.
articles.titleCn: 当需求相互作用：通过相互依赖规范扩展长时程编码
articles.abstractCn: 要在现实世界的长周期软件开发中取得成功，编码代理必须满足多维度的任务规范，例如接口兼容性和错误处理，同时又不破坏现有的依赖关系。然而，当前的研究工作在规范的数量和多样性上都存在不足，往往强调主要目标而忽略复杂的约束。为了弥补这一差距，合成任务面临着两个挑战：盲目添加规范可能导致任务简化为琐碎的检查清单，而非强制联合推理；验证这些微妙交互则可能遗漏隐藏的缺陷或拒绝有效的替代方案。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了CodeSpecWeave框架，这是一个用于合成具有丰富、相互依赖规范的任务的框架。基于真实开发者种子，合成代理会迭代地开发耦合的任务需求和可执行的测试，而审查代理会从多个模型审计解决方案轨迹，以确保测试的可靠性。利用该流程，我们在2,865个仓库中构建了4,670个训练任务。在DeepSWE-v1.1上应用强化学习于这些任务，显著提升了性能，大幅超越了现有基线模型。此外，我们还策划了CodeSpecWeave-Bench，这是一个严格的基准，包含100个任务和1,044个规范，它清晰地分离了前沿模型，并揭示了在处理相互依赖的工程约束方面存在显著的空间。

articles.title: Judged in Company: In-Context Batching Makes LLM Verdicts Depend on Other Items
articles.abstract: To save cost, practitioners often ask a language model to grade many independent items in one prompt. This assumes that verdicts are separable: that the verdict on an item does not depend on the other items in the prompt or on its position among them. Across three judgement tasks (harm in social-media comments, short-answer grading and review star ratings) and five open-weight models with 4-9B parameters, assigning the same 2,000 items to different random batches of 25 changes 11-22% of decisions on harm and grading, 6.5-13.3 points more than renaming the item keys or rewording the instruction, while AUROC against human labels differs from single-item grading only by -0.033 to +0.010; for four models with 14-32B parameters, 6-15% of decisions change, 4.2-9.1 points more. We show that flip rates decompose exactly into components of order, slot and membership, and that under a threshold model they grow with the square root of the variance that the context contributes, so that effects that are small for scores are large for decisions. Most of the latent dissimilarity between partitions comes from the order of the neighbours and the slot. The main effect of which items share the prompt, the part that voting over permutations of a batch cannot remove, accounts for 0.11-0.22 of it, and majority votes over nine permutations still leave 52-60% of the flips. Batched verdicts also differ systematically from single-item verdicts: even the majority of fifteen random batches disagrees with them on 8.4-17.8% of decisions. Editing a single generation shows that both the model's own earlier verdicts and the neighbours' texts carry the effect. On the easy task, star ratings, only 2.9-3.9% of decisions change. We recommend grading ambiguous items one per prompt, recovering most of the cost with a cached prefix, and reporting agreement with single-item grading whenever items are batched.
articles.titleCn: 在公司中评判：上下文批量处理使大型语言模型的裁决依赖于其他项目
articles.abstractCn: 为节省成本，从业者常让语言模型在一个提示中评估多个独立项目。这假设了判断的可分离性：即一个项目的判断结果不依赖于提示中的其他项目或其在其中的位置。在三个判断任务（社交媒体评论中的危害性、简答题评分和评论星级评分）和五个参数量为4-9B的开权模型中，将相同的2000个项目分配到不同的25个随机批次中，会改变11-22%的危害性和评分判断，比重命名项目键或重写指令多出6.5-13.3分，而与人类标签的AUROC差异仅-0.033至+0.010；对于参数量为14-32B的四个模型，会改变6-15%的判断，多出4.2-9.1分。我们证明翻转率可以精确分解为顺序、槽位和成员资格的分量，在阈值模型下，它们随着上下文贡献方差的平方根增长，因此对分数影响小的效应对判断影响大。分区之间的潜在差异主要来自邻居的顺序和槽位。项目共享提示的主要效应，即投票无法消除的部分，占0.11-0.22，九次排列中的多数投票仍留下52-60%的翻转。批量判断与单项判断也存在系统性差异：即使十五个随机批次的多数也不同意单项判断的8.4-17.8%的判断。编辑单个生成显示，模型自身的早期判断和邻居文本都携带了这种效应。在简单的任务星级评分中，仅改变2.9-3.9%的判断。我们建议对模糊项目每提示评估一个，使用缓存的提示前缀大部分恢复成本，并在项目批量时报告与单项判断的一致性。

articles.title: ScienceJudge: Pattern Perturbation Augmentation for Sentence-Level Scientific Claim Verification
articles.abstract: Sentence-level scientific claim verification determines whether each sentence in an AI-generated scientific paragraph is supported by a given multimodal evidence bundle. Fine-grained reporting errors often preserve fluent and plausible statements while introducing subtle evidence-claim deviations, making them difficult to detect under sparse and imbalanced supervision. We propose Pattern Perturbation Augmentation (PPA), which models reporting errors as label-specific faithfulness breaking transformations and induces reusable error patterns from labeled examples. PPA applies these patterns to supported claims to construct controlled hard negatives and expands their coverage through pattern-level, operation-level, and cross-domain augmentation. Based on these augmented views, we develop ScienceJudge, which integrates PPA-trained vision-language predictors and instruction-guided LLM predictors through class-weighted ensemble inference. On the local development set, ScienceJudge improves the average score from 0.8124 to 0.8692, achieving a Macro-F1 of 0.8466 and a Paragraph Exact Match score of 0.8919. Our submitted system ranks first on the official NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1 leaderboard with a final score of 0.6890.
articles.titleCn: ScienceJudge：句子级科学声明验证的图模式扰动增强
articles.abstractCn: 句子级别的科学声明验证旨在确定人工智能生成的科学段落中的每一句话是否得到了给定的多模态证据包的支持。细粒度的报告错误往往保留流畅且看似合理的陈述，同时引入微妙的证据声明偏差，在稀疏且不平衡的监督下难以检测。我们提出了模式扰动增强（PPA），该技术将报告错误建模为特定标签的忠诚度破坏转换，并从标记示例中诱导可重用的错误模式。PPA将这些模式应用于已支持的声明，以构建受控的难负例，并通过模式级、操作级和跨域增强扩展其覆盖范围。基于这些增强视图，我们开发了ScienceJudge，该系统通过类别加权集成推理整合了PPA训练的视觉语言预测器和指令引导的大型语言模型预测器。在本地开发集上，ScienceJudge将平均分数从0.8124提高到0.8692，实现了宏观F1值0.8466和段落精确匹配分数0.8919。我们的提交系统在官方NLPCC 2026任务10赛道1排行榜上排名第一，最终得分为0.6890。

articles.title: Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages
articles.abstract: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.
articles.titleCn: 动员档案：从档案文献中大规模提取双语文本，用于极低资源语言
articles.abstractCn: 虽然从网页中挖掘平行句对于低资源机器翻译已被证明是有效的，但世界上大多数语言几乎没有或完全没有网络存在。然而，它们拥有语言学家经过数百年努力积累的资源，例如语法、词典和其他文献资料。我们提出从这些语言资源中提取翻译示例，为在线代表性不足的语言提供平行数据，并有可能扩展到数千种更多语言。我们开发了一个流程来实现这一目标，利用光学字符识别（OCR）模型和视觉语言模型（VLM），以确保识别的内容与视觉布局信息对齐。我们展示了提取的比特文本在跨20种语言启动翻译系统方面的效用，通过训练机器翻译模型和在大型语言模型中应用情境学习。在情境学习中，我们观察到在低资源和高资源语言中，与零样本翻译相比，chrF2++分别提升了+15.78和+6.94。

articles.title: EpiAgent: Epistemic Self-Play for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Epistemic game theory explains an agent's strategic behavior via the beliefs it holds about others and how these beliefs are updated as the interactions unfold. Modern LLM-based agents, however, often lack an explicit mechanism for learning and updating such beliefs to guide decisions under incomplete information. To bridge this gap, we propose EpiAgent, a framework that equips LLM-based agents with an explicit, learnable epistemic layer, which maintains beliefs over others' private information and combines these beliefs with the agent's available information into an epistemic state for action selection. Concretely, the agent's policy is decomposed into two coupled stages: Epistemic Update, which updates these beliefs from interaction histories, and Action Planning, which selects actions conditioned on the updated epistemic state. By formulating their dependency as a bi-level optimization problem, we introduce Epistemic Self-Play, an algorithm that alternately optimizes the two stages through self-play, utilizing an intrinsic prediction reward to evaluate how well inferred beliefs predict subsequent observations. Empirical results across both mixed and competitive scenarios show that EpiAgent consistently outperforms prompting-based and RL-based baselines. Further analyses reveal the benefits of dedicated epistemic training, improvements in belief inference accuracy, and the contribution of learned beliefs to action planning. These results demonstrate the value of an explicit, learnable epistemic layer for effective multi-agent interactions.
articles.titleCn: EpiAgent：用于LLM智能体的认知自我博弈
