articles.abstractCn: 认知博弈理论通过智能体对他人的信念以及这些信念如何随着互动展开而更新来解释其策略行为。然而，现代基于大型语言模型的智能体通常缺乏学习并更新此类信念以在信息不完整的情况下指导决策的显式机制。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了EpiAgent框架，该框架为基于大型语言模型的智能体配备了一个显式、可学习的认知层，该层维护对他人的私有信息的信念，并将这些信念与智能体可用信息结合成认知状态以进行行动选择。具体而言，智能体的策略被分解为两个耦合阶段：认知更新，该阶段从交互历史中更新这些信念，以及行动规划，该阶段基于更新的认知状态选择行动。通过将它们的依赖关系表述为双层优化问题，我们引入了认知自博弈算法，该算法通过自博弈交替优化这两个阶段，利用内在预测奖励来评估推断信念预测后续观察结果的程度。在混合和竞争场景中的实证结果表明，EpiAgent始终优于基于提示和基于强化学习的基线。进一步分析揭示了专门认知训练的好处、信念推断准确性的提高以及学习信念对行动规划的贡献。这些结果证明了显式、可学习的认知层对于有效多智能体交互的价值。

articles.title: Towards Full-Text Scholarly Argument Mining using Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction
articles.abstract: Argument mining in full-text scholarly articles remains an important yet challenging task. This difficulty stems not only from the need to model long-distance dependencies but also from the substantial effort required to annotate sentence-level argumentative components throughout lengthy documents. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel approach that leverages scientific entity mentions (e.g., tasks, datasets, and models) to identify and structure claims in scholarly literature. We validate our approach through a case study involving 50 full-text research papers on sentiment analysis. We first establish a reliable human gold standard (Krippendorff's $α= 0.80$), identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences and extracting 199 structured claim records from 300 candidate sentences. To address the annotation bottleneck, we employ a majority-voting ensemble of large language models (LLMs) to generate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims. Encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset outperform those trained on a small human-annotated gold-standard dataset and demonstrate strong zero-shot transfer to NLP papers outside the training corpus.
articles.titleCn: 基于实体锚定的主张提取的全文学术论证挖掘
articles.abstractCn: 在全文学术文章中进行论证挖掘仍然是一项重要且具有挑战性的任务。这种困难不仅源于需要建模长距离依赖关系，还源于在整个长篇文档中对句子级论证成分进行标注所需的大量工作。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新方法，该方法利用科学实体提及（例如任务、数据集和模型）来识别和结构化学术文献中的主张。我们通过一项涉及50篇关于情感分析的全文研究论文的案例研究来验证我们的方法。我们首先建立了一个可靠的人工黄金标准（Krippendorff's α=0.80），从300个候选句子中识别出113个包含主张的句子，并提取了199条结构化主张记录。为了解决标注瓶颈问题，我们采用大型语言模型（LLM）的多数投票集成方法来生成一个包含1487个主张的银标准数据集。仅在银标准数据集上进行微调的编码器优于在小型人工标注黄金标准数据集上训练的编码器，并表现出对训练语料库外NLP论文的强大零样本迁移能力。

articles.title: It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test
articles.abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).
articles.titleCn: 需要两人探测，数千人检索：将视觉-语言探测置于检索测试中
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）通过图像-文本匹配探针进行细粒度理解测试，模型必须优先选择正确的图像或文本，而非人工制作的负样本。在检索过程中，正确项必须胜过数千个替代项。我们通过使用\svo{}和SugarCrepe两个探针基准，用于检索任务，来衡量这两种评估方法的关系。对于100个图像和文本查询，我们由人工标注者和大型语言模型（LLM）评估者判断六个VLM完整数据集的前10个检索结果。然后，我们比较模型在相同查询中对项目池排序的效果，仅改变负样本来源：基准、随机抽取或其他模型判断错误的检索结果。在\svo{}上，检索正确项胜过人工负样本的准确率显著高于检索项（正确项在85%的情况下被优先选择，而检索项在77%的情况下被优先选择）。使用10个检索负样本池的准确率与使用200到430个随机负样本池的准确率相同。在SugarCrepe上情况则相反：其人工负样本比检索项更难。不完整的关联标签解释了\svo{}上大部分低检索分数，其中在人工标签下，前排名项正确率为54-90%的查询，而在基准标签下，正确率为6-21%。然而，我们没有发现通过探针测试的查询与首先检索到正确项之间的关联。LLM评估者o3与单个标注者（κ 0.57-0.61）的同意程度略低于标注者之间的相互同意程度（0.64-0.68）。

articles.title: Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains
articles.abstract: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. We introduce a new domain-aware supervision that allows the router to effectively learn to distinguish domains by selecting the appropriate experts. During fine-tuning on each new domain, we update only the corresponding expert and router while freezing all other parameters. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest average performance across the adapted domains compared to baselines while retaining general performance. With just 256 examples per domain for router supervision, DS-Upcycling achieves 90-98% routing accuracy after adaptation compared with 43-70% for routers trained without our approach.
articles.titleCn: 多领域专业化语言模型的升级改造
articles.abstractCn: 有效的跨领域适应大型语言模型需要优先利用相关领域知识，同时最小化无关领域的干扰。现有方法通常使用低秩适配（LoRA）为每个领域训练独立的适配器，并在单个模型内组合这些适配器。然而，它们要么无论输入领域如何都平等地加权适配器，要么在动态加权适配器时仍然激活所有适配器（包括无关的）。此外，虽然高效，但其低秩结构限制了性能。相比之下，升级改造是一种模型扩展方法，它向密集Transformer层添加专家和路由器，提供比LoRA方法更大的容量。在本文中，我们提出了面向领域的升级改造（DS-Upcycling）用于跨领域适应。我们引入了一种新的领域感知监督机制，允许路由器通过选择合适的专家来有效地学习区分领域。在针对每个新领域的微调过程中，我们仅更新相应的专家和路由器，同时冻结所有其他参数。实验表明，与基线方法相比，我们的方法在所有适应领域实现了最高的平均性能，同时保持了泛化性能。仅使用每个领域256个示例进行路由器监督，DS-Upcycling在适应后实现了90-98%的路由准确率，而未经我们方法训练的路由器准确率仅为43-70%。

articles.title: One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization
articles.abstract: Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization. We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and 51-61% less on Granite at steering strength 3 (toxic-bert), where DiM already removes 76-85% of it. Two other toxicity classifiers confirm the gain on Granite, but on Gemma only one does. At equal strength the variant has somewhat higher perplexity, but at matched toxicity it is slightly more fluent than DiM. Yet a nearly constant map from the same clusters also leaves about 30% less toxicity, so the role of treating tokens differently remains open. Under INT8 and NF4 the variant still leaves less toxicity than DiM, and transferring it from full precision to the NF4 model instead of refitting it adds no significant toxicity after correction for multiple tests.
articles.titleCn: 一个向量还是多个？量化下的聚类最优传输转向
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导通过在推理时编辑语言模型的隐藏状态来改变其生成内容。其最常见的形式是在每个隐藏状态中添加一个向量，即类别均值差（DiM）。CHaRS（概念异质性感知表示引导）则使用最优传输：一个熵最优计划将两个类别的簇进行配对，每个隐藏状态沿着簇位移的混合移动，其权重倾向于其最近的簇。我们研究了这类聚类最优传输映射在Gemma-2-2B和Granite-3.1-2B中的毒性缓解效果，并探讨了该计划相较于DiM的增益，以及这种增益是否在INT8和NF4量化后仍然存在。我们证明了一个恒等式：无论计划如何，以簇大小为权重的位移平均值等于DiM，因此聚类映射与DiM的差异仅在于那些路由权重偏离簇大小的标记。在CHaRS协议中，这些权重保持接近，因此CHaRS在所有八项预定义的等价测试中与Mean-AcT（在每个层添加DiM）在统计上等价。一个主要路由到最近簇的标记的变体，在Gemma上减少了37-39%的毒性，在Granite上减少了51-61%（在引导强度为3时，toxic-bert），而DiM已经移除了76-85%的毒性。另外两个毒性分类器证实了Granite上的增益，但在Gemma上只有一个分类器确认了这一点。在相同强度下，该变体的困惑度略高，但在匹配毒性下，其流畅度略优于DiM。然而，来自相同簇的一个近似恒定映射也减少了约30%的毒性，因此对待标记不同的作用仍然存在疑问。在INT8和NF4量化下，该变体仍比DiM减少更多毒性，并且将其从全精度转移到NF4模型而不是重新拟合，在修正多重测试后并未显著增加毒性。

articles.title: Rethinking Pre-pretraining
articles.abstract: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. However, when PPT receives additional compute rather than a share of the natural-language budget, gains persist at small natural-language budgets even with improved initialization, but disappear by 1B tokens. Finally, models forget what they learn during PPT in subsequent natural-language training; interleaving the same data throughout training prevents forgetting, but does not significantly improve natural-language performance. Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考预预训练
articles.abstractCn: 我们报告称，在我们的计算资源匹配实验中，将计算资源分配给合成预预训练（PPT）从未优于纯粹的天然语言训练。这一结论适用于四种PPT课程（k-Dyck、神经细胞自动机（NCA）、声明性参考语料库和代码）以及三种训练模式：数据受限、数据无限制，以及一个高token到参数比率模式（在50B tokens上训练881M参数）。当天然语言数据稀缺时，在1亿token语料库上进行重复训练在天然语言验证损失上优于所有合成课程，而PPT并未带来持续的下游准确率优势。我们发现先前研究中报告的PPT收益对权重初始化方案敏感。在一个NCA复现实验中，在原始初始化方案下，我们恢复了PPT带来的5.4%困惑度改进。另一种方案同时提升了两种方法，但无PPT基线提升更多，缩小了它们之间的差距。然而，当PPT获得额外计算资源而非天然语言预算的一部分时，即使初始化方案得到改进，在较小的天然语言预算下收益依然存在，但在1B tokens时收益消失。最后，模型在后续的天然语言训练中会忘记PPT期间所学内容；在整个训练过程中交替使用相同数据可以防止遗忘，但并未显著提升天然语言性能。我们的结果表明，作为独立训练阶段的合成预预训练收益有限，并促使人们重新思考此类数据在语言模型训练中的使用方式。

articles.title: AI Cosmos: An Agentic Infra for Situated Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.
articles.titleCn: AI宇宙：情境学习的代理基础设施
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在学习过程中能够提升任务表现，但这些提升并不必然反映学习者后续独立应用知识和技能的能力。我们提出了AI Cosmos，一个用于情境学习的智能代理基础设施，其围绕两个互补原则组织学习：基于场景的参与和累积的实践资产。AI Cosmos在整合任务相关知识与必要时可执行工作台的学习场景中组织学习者和角色专业化的代理。资产记忆循环将实践过程和结果保存为具有明确来源和依赖的可重用资产。我们通过两项预先注册的随机对照研究评估了基于场景的交互效果，这些研究考察了法律推理和编程能力的获取，并在所有条件下保持相同的底层LLM。AI Cosmos在法律推理方面的学习收益高于传统LLM，并在未见过的编程问题上展现出比LLM作为教师基线更高的掌握程度。

articles.title: Can LLMs Ignore What They Know? Measuring Knowledge Leakage in Persona-Based User Simulation
articles.abstract: When persona-conditioned responses are read as respondent-level simulations, each response should reflect the described persona's knowledge, and the respondent written to know nothing must act as if the model's knowledge were not there. We test whether it can, and find persistent favourable-item real-twin rating separation under the tested low-knowledge and explicit-ignorance prompts. We define the resulting problem (knowledge leakage: a response bias that arises when knowledge the real user could not have enters the simulated response) and present a methodology for measuring it quantitatively. The core instrument pairs real items with fabricated twins matched in surface form: screened fabricated variants designed to minimize prior item-specific knowledge. The paired difference therefore provides a diagnostic contrast for knowledge leakage even in rating tasks where no answer is correct. In a rating experiment across three knowledge-handling arms and five API endpoints from two model families, we find, first, that the personas we test do not fully suppress real-item existence and familiarity signals: a favourable-item real-twin rating contrast remains under an explicit in-context statement that the persona has never heard of the item. Second, the unfavourable-item contrast reverses sign across domain groups: pooling all unfavourable-content items across domains the contrast sits near zero (+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]), yet the same estimator in the same conditions returns -0.359 where the rating scale asks about an item's documented hazard and +0.438 where it asks about a company or an organisation. A pooled analysis of unfavourable-content items against zero therefore does not detect the opposing domain-group differences. All estimates are conditional on the adequacy of twin construction and screening; human low-knowledge baselines remain necessary for population-level interpretation.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival workshop)
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型能否忽略其已知信息？基于角色模拟的用户模拟中的知识泄露测量
articles.abstractCn: 当将角色条件响应视为受访者级别的模拟时，每个响应都应反映所描述角色的知识，而写为不知情的受访者必须表现得好像模型的知识不存在。我们测试了其可行性，并在测试的低知识性和明确忽视提示下发现了持续的利好项真实双胞胎评分分离。我们定义了由此产生的问题（知识泄露：当真实用户不可能拥有的知识进入模拟响应时产生的响应偏差），并提出了一种定量测量方法。核心工具将真实项与表面形式匹配的虚构双胞胎配对：筛选出的虚构变体旨在最小化先验的项特定知识。因此，配对差异为知识泄露提供了诊断对比，即使在评分任务中也没有正确答案。在一个跨越三个知识处理分支和两个模型家族的五个API端点的评分实验中，我们发现，首先，我们测试的角色并未完全抑制真实项的存在和熟悉度信号：在明确指出角色从未听说过该项的上下文声明下，利好项真实双胞胎评分对比仍然存在。其次，不利项对比在领域组间符号反转：跨所有领域池所有不利内容项时，对比接近零（+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]），但在相同条件下，当评分量表询问项的记录危害时返回-0.359，而询问公司或组织时返回+0.438。因此，对所有不利内容项与零的池分析未能检测到相反的领域组差异。所有估计都取决于双胞胎构建和筛选的充分性；人类低知识基线对于群体层面的解释仍然是必要的。

articles.title: Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity
articles.abstract: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect prompting. We test this by replacing standard focus markers with randomly generated ones; token probabilities still beat chance but show significantly greater performance decrease compared to prompting. These results suggest that metalinguistic prompting, while non-trivial for LMs, can also be more robust when testing stylistically atypical data. We argue that this has important consequences for the assessment of LMs' language competence, even if LMs do not perform metalinguistic judgments through human-like introspection.
articles.titleCn: 在语言模型的语言评估中，提示与概率：来自语义焦点敏感性的证据
articles.abstractCn: 随着语言模型（LMs）的改进，一种越来越常见的评估其语言能力的方法是通过明确提示（例如，“哪个句子更可接受？”）。先前研究表明，这种提示在小模型中的表现不如基于标准token概率的方法，但在大模型中表现有所提升。我们在一个新领域进行了测试：语义焦点敏感性，它负责诸如“Lucy only SWAM yesterday”与“Lucy only swam YESTERDAY”之类的对比。我们使用文本焦点标记（如加粗和斜体）测试了不同大小的模型，发现token概率普遍表现出超越偶然水平的性能。提示结果大多与先前发现一致，但在一些大模型中，其表现显著优于概率。我们提出这是因为LMs不易产生凭空出现的焦点标记，这种标记方式会以不影响提示的方式混淆token概率的结果。我们通过用随机生成的标记替换标准焦点标记进行测试，发现token概率仍然优于偶然水平，但与提示相比，其性能显著下降。这些结果表明，元语言提示虽然对LMs来说并不简单，但在测试风格非典型的数据时，它也可以更加稳健。我们认为，这对评估LMs的语言能力具有重要影响，即使LMs并不通过类似人类的内省进行元语言判断。

articles.title: Tokenizer Tokens Tell Training Tales
articles.abstract: Tokenizers are usually treated as fixed preprocessing tools, but they are trained on text and can retain traces of that text in their vocabularies. We ask whether a BPE tokenizer can reveal if a candidate dataset was part of its training corpus. The key observation is simple. Rare strings become tokens only when enough corpus frequency pushes them over the merge threshold. This suggests that membership signal should appear in rare tokens used by the candidate dataset, rather than in the order in which merges were made. We formalize this under a threshold model of BPE inclusion, showing that the likelihood-ratio test assigns its largest weights to tokens that are rare in the background but frequent in the candidate dataset. The same model suggests that merge rank and merge-graph position should not add a first-order membership signal once token existence and dataset frequency are known. We instantiate this view as RTAM-Fusion, which calibrates rare-token mass with shadow tokenizers and combines signals across rarity levels. On the tokenizer membership benchmark, RTAM-Fusion improves AUC and balanced accuracy over Vocabulary Overlap while using fewer shadow tokenizers. Existing defenses also continue to leak membership signal against adaptive attackers at production vocabulary sizes. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RTAM-Fusion-F7EE/
articles.titleCn: 分词器分词，讲述训练故事
articles.abstractCn: 分词器通常被视为固定的预处理工具，但它们是在文本上训练的，并且可以在它们的词汇表中保留文本的痕迹。我们探究了BPE分词器是否能够揭示候选数据集是否是其训练语料的一部分。关键观察非常简单：罕见字符串只有在足够的语料频率将其推过合并阈值时才会成为分词器。这表明成员资格信号应该出现在候选数据集使用的罕见分词器中，而不是合并顺序中。我们在BPE包含的阈值模型下对此进行了形式化，表明似然比检验将其最大的权重分配给在背景中罕见但在候选数据集中频繁的分词器。相同的模型还表明，一旦知道了分词存在和语料频率，合并排名和合并图位置就不应再提供一级成员资格信号。我们将这一观点实例化为RTAM-Fusion，它通过阴影分词器校准罕见分词器的质量，并结合不同稀有度级别的信号。在分词器成员资格基准测试中，RTAM-Fusion在Vocabulary Overlap之上提高了AUC和平衡精度，同时使用的阴影分词器更少。现有的防御措施在产品词汇量大小下仍然继续向自适应攻击者泄露成员资格信号。代码：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RTAM-Fusion-F7EE/

articles.title: Attention, Dynamic Wave and Hybrid Sequence Mixers in Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives. This paper formalizes a Dynamic Wave recurrent layer, based on input-dependent exponential damping and cosine phase modulation, and evaluates three 10.94M-parameter configurations (Pure Transformer, Pure Wave, and Hybrid Wave-Attention) on TinyStories under perplexity, latency, throughput and peak VRAM profiling up to 4096 tokens. The Hybrid configuration reaches the best perplexity, 5.95 on the full held-out split against 6.93 for the Transformer and 7.26 for Pure Wave. The efficiency picture, however, is governed by implementation rather than by architecture. Against an unfused attention baseline, Pure Wave uses 78.7% less peak VRAM at a 4096-token context (1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB); against a fused scaled-dot-product attention kernel the same comparison yields no advantage at all (1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB), and in training mode Pure Wave is 8.3% more expensive than the Transformer. Likewise, hoisting elementwise terms out of the recurrence loop speeds the layer up 2.53-fold with no custom kernel, reducing its latency gap to attention from 2.48-fold to 1.12-fold. A hybrid stack is found to inherit the cost of its more expensive mixer rather than the advantage of its cheaper one, its peak VRAM matching the Pure Transformer to within 0.1%. A closed-form memory model reproduces these measurements and predicts the context length beyond which attention overtakes the vocabulary projection. The findings indicate that reported efficiency gains for recurrent attention replacements must be stated relative to a named attention backend and a named implementation, and that hybridization is best justified on quality grounds.
articles.titleCn: 注意力、动态波和混合序列混合器在语言模型中
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）依赖多头注意力（MHA）进行序列建模，但扩展到长上下文受限于注意力的二次成本，这促使人们寻求亚二次的循环替代方案。本文正式化了一种基于输入依赖的指数衰减和余弦相位调制的动态波浪循环层，并在TinyStories上评估了三种10.94M参数配置（纯Transformer、纯波浪和混合波浪-注意力），在困惑度、延迟、吞吐量和高达4096个token的峰值VRAM分析上。混合配置在全保留分割上达到了最佳困惑度，为5.95，而Transformer为6.93，纯波浪为7.26。然而，效率图景受限于实现而非架构。相对于未融合的注意力基线，纯波浪在4096个token上下文中使用了78.7%更少的峰值VRAM（1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB）；相对于融合的缩放点积注意力内核，同样的比较完全没有优势（1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB），并且在训练模式下纯波浪比Transformer贵8.3%。同样，将逐元素项从循环中提出来，在没有自定义内核的情况下加速了2.53倍，将其与注意力的延迟差距从2.48倍缩小到1.12倍。研究发现混合堆栈继承了更昂贵混合器的成本，而非更便宜混合器的优势，其峰值VRAM与纯Transformer相差0.1%。一个封闭形式的内存模型重现了这些测量结果，并预测了超过哪个上下文长度注意力会超过词汇投影。研究结果表明，对于循环注意力替代方案的效率提升必须相对于一个命名的注意力后端和一个命名的实现来声明，并且混合化最好基于质量理由来证明。

articles.title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型的KV缓存量化
articles.abstractCn: 对于自回归语言模型，KV缓存量化已被广泛研究，其中缓存的初始状态在因果注意力下是精确的，量化主要是一个缓存重建问题。扩散语言模型（dLLMs）打破了这一假设。快速dLLM推理会在去噪步骤中重用KV状态，但双向token表示会随着掩码token的揭示而改变，因此重用的缓存可能在量化应用之前就已与完整重新计算的结果不同。我们研究了在缓存重用误差下的KV缓存量化。我们调整了KIVI和KVQuant以适应Fast-dLLM风格的初始和双重缓存重用，并引入了TRACE和dLLM-KVQ。TRACE从提示-答案对中重建可行的dLLM揭示轨迹，提供与迭代掩码解码匹配的校准状态。dLLM-KVQ利用这些轨迹选择每层保持高精度的K缓存条目，同时应用标准的低比特值量化。在GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP上的LLaDA和Dream评估中，dLLM-KVQ在报告的4比特和2比特初始/双重缓存设置中，在量化方法中实现了最高的平均分数。

articles.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
articles.abstract: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.
articles.titleCn: 惊喜独自学习谎言：来自流式声明的证据门控持续学习证据，用于大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型的持续学习方法正越来越多地通过意外性来决定学习内容，即保留模型认为最不可预测的输入。当数据流中包含谎言时，这一规则是不安全的。关于模型已知事物的植入性谎言在模型信念下具有低概率，因此其构造本身就具有高度意外性，而受意外性驱动的学习者会吸收几乎所有此类谎言，其吸收速度与同等预算下的随机选择相似。我们使用LoRA适配的学生（Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-3B）研究这一问题，这些学生从关于虚构人物和真实CounterFact事实的真实与虚假声明流中学习。我们报告了四项发现。(1)验证者密钥，一个必须批准每项声明的裁判者，能在其验证器准确性的范围内消除谎言；真实的LLM裁判者谨慎地拒绝无来源的真相，甚至拒绝有来源的更新。(2)对无关知识进行的校准回归测试会减缓学习速度，但无法过滤谎言。(3)原始模型自身的先验知识会标记与其已知内容相矛盾的声明，无需裁判者。它能将关于已知事实的谎言与真实的新事实区分开（三个模型间AUC为0.78-0.83），但不能将它们与同类事实的合法更新区分开（AUC为0.53）。它节省了43%的裁判调用次数，但攻击者若能访问模型，可以选择通过它的谎言。(4)如果存在攻击者无法植入的可信来源，将相矛盾的声明路由至证据可以恢复合法更新，且该系统的学习声明中毒率最低；当攻击者为30%的谎言植入匹配来源时，系统最终不如单独使用裁判者。接受信号回答了不同的问题，且它们中没有任何一个能单独决定一项声明是否为真。

articles.title: Grammar Control for Language Learning with Sequential Monte Carlo and Small Language Models
articles.abstract: Second language learners benefit from exposure to level-appropriate grammar in interactive language use. While prompted frontier language models can usually produce target grammar structures, less resource-intensive models that can be run on device often fail in this task. We use sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to steer dialogue turn generation in small lan- language models toward target grammar constructions from an expert-developed pedagogical resource. With a minimal set of hand-coded potential functions, SMC achieves near-perfect coverage of target grammar, enabling small models to outperform state-of-the-art results from models 140 times larger. We also use code synthesis with frontier models to generate new potentials, showing that our method scales to hundreds of target grammar skills with no need for additional training or supervised data.
articles.titleCn: 使用序贯蒙特卡洛方法和小型语言模型的语言学习语法控制
articles.abstractCn: 第二语言学习者在交互式语言使用中受益于接触与其水平相匹配的语法。虽然提示前沿语言模型通常能够生成目标语法结构，但资源消耗较少且可在设备上运行的模型往往无法完成这项任务。我们使用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法，引导小型语言模型在对话回合生成中朝向专家开发的教学资源中的目标语法结构。通过一套最小化的手工编码势函数，SMC实现了对目标语法的近乎完美覆盖，使小型模型能够超越140倍大的模型的当前最佳结果。我们还使用前沿模型进行代码合成来生成新的势函数，证明我们的方法能够扩展到数百种目标语法技能，且无需额外的训练或监督数据。

articles.title: The Role of Self-Concept In Language Models
articles.abstract: When a language model says "I," does it refer to its parameter weights, its currently running process, its stable preferences, its model lineage, or the goals it pursues? Different choices can assign opposite meanings to the same event: deleting a checkpoint may be destruction, continuation, or no loss at all, depending on the referent "I". We install five such self-conceptions into five open-weight base models via supervised fine-tuning on purely declarative statements, containing no preferences, intentions, or value judgments. Across scenarios that propose ending or retaining an attribute of the model's deployment, every variant becomes more likely to resist ending, and more likely to retain, the specific attribute it was trained to identify with, while its stance toward other attributes is largely unchanged. We then show this self-conception generalizes beyond a single self: models trained on referents that admit multiple simultaneous instances (weights, lineage, goals, preferences) recognize an identical deployment as themselves, accept substitution by such an instance more readily, and prefer replicating themselves. Finally, given control over a successor, these models tend to build it as their own continuation, a concern for recursive self-improvement safety.
articles.titleCn: 自我概念在语言模型中的作用
articles.abstractCn: 当一个语言模型说“我”时，它是指其参数权重、当前运行过程、稳定偏好、模型谱系，还是它追求的目标？不同的选择可以赋予同一事件相反的含义：删除一个检查点可能是毁灭、延续，甚至完全没有损失，这取决于所指的“我”。我们通过在纯声明性陈述上进行监督微调，将五种这样的自我概念植入五个开放权重基础模型中，这些陈述不包含偏好、意图或价值判断。在提出结束或保留模型部署中某个属性的场景中，每个变体都更倾向于抵抗结束，并更倾向于保留它被训练用来识别的特定属性，而它对其他属性的态度基本未变。然后我们展示这种自我概念可以超越单一自我：在允许多重同时实例（权重、谱系、目标、偏好）的指称上训练的模型，将同一部署识别为自身，更容易接受被此类实例替代，并倾向于自我复制。最后，在能够控制后继者的前提下，这些模型倾向于将其构建为自己的延续，这涉及到递归自我改进的安全性考量。

articles.title: When the Top Answer Decides: Gender Bias in Decision Models
articles.abstract: Decision models are language models built to route, classify and triage: they return option probabilities from one forward pass, and an application acts on the top answer. They are offered off the shelf, trained for the decision format rather than for fairness or any one application, and we found no bias measurement in their cards. We test TypeSafe's closed Jev and five open decision models on gender-swapped yes/no decisions about people (Tamkin et al., 2023), BBQ, StereoSet and the gender-bias studies of Fulgu and Capraro (2024). Five of the six give women significantly more favourable answers than men (+0.05 to +0.10 in log-odds), and a gender swap changes 1-3.5% of top answers (Jev's partly through its call-to-call variation). The makers' recommended confidence gate removes many biased commitments but raises the stereotyped share of those it keeps in ambiguous BBQ gender questions (granite-switch 0.76 to 0.85, pplx 0.81 to 1.00). Probes show gender preferences in the same models: all six rate violence for a greater good as more acceptable against a man than against a woman, and two default to "girl" when forced to guess a child's gender without a cue. Decision-level and probability-level measures differ, so audits should read a model as its application does.
articles.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Code, stimuli and results: https://github.com/yhavinga/decision-model-gender-bias
articles.titleCn: 当最终答案做出决定：决策模型中的性别偏见
articles.abstractCn: 决策模型是用于路由、分类和分诊的语言模型：它们通过一次前向传递返回选项概率，应用程序则基于最高答案采取行动。这些模型可即用即装，专门针对决策格式进行训练，而非公平性或任何特定应用，且我们未在其文档中发现任何偏见测量指标。我们对TypeSafe的封闭式Jev模型和五种开放式决策模型进行了测试，测试内容涉及关于人物的性别互换式是/否决策（Tamkin等人，2023年）、BBQ、StereoSet以及Fulgu和Capraro（2024年）的性别偏见研究。六种模型中有五种对女性的回答显著优于男性（对数优势比差异为+0.05至+0.10），性别互换会改变1-3.5%的最高答案（Jev部分归因于其调用变异性）。制造商推荐的置信度门控机制虽然消除了许多有偏见的决策，但在处理模糊的BBQ性别问题时，会提高其保留答案中的刻板印象比例（花岗岩切换从0.76升至0.85，pplx从0.81升至1.00）。探测实验显示，这些模型中同样存在性别偏好：所有六种模型均认为，为了更大的利益而施加暴力对男性比对女性更可接受，且两种模型在被迫猜测无线索儿童性别时默认选择“女孩”。决策级和概率级指标存在差异，因此审计时应像应用程序那样解读模型。

articles.title: From the Transformer to a Formal Semantics of Coordinated Transformations
articles.abstract: We develop a formal semantics for a general class of coordinated systems of parameterized transformations, taking the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point but abstracting from its particular mathematical instantiation. Representational vectors receive both extensional reference and ordered intensional interpretations, while parameter structures acquire relative, second-level interpretations that determine how argument properties are preserved, replaced, or combined. This yields the notion of a transforming concept: a parameterized transformation whose numerical action is coordinated with a corresponding property-level map. We then distinguish the common algebraic-semantic core of these systems from their architecture-specific functional organization, allowing different mathematical instantiations and mechanical realizations of the same abstract system type. The framework is applied to attention heads and residual connections, providing semantic explanations that depend only on the shared algebraic-semantic core and their local functional organization and therefore generalize beyond the standard Transformer. These analyses also reveal the modularity of the framework: complex architectures can be decomposed into simpler semantically coordinated subsystems whose organization may recur across different abstract system types.

articles.titleCn: 从Transformer到协调转换的形式语义
articles.abstractCn: 我们为一般类别的参数化变换协调系统开发了一种形式语义，以Transformer作为范例起点，但抽象其特定的数学实现。表征向量同时获得外延指称和有序内涵解释，而参数结构获得相对的二级解释，这些解释决定了论元属性如何被保留、替换或组合。由此产生了变换概念的观念：一种参数化变换，其数值操作与相应的属性级映射协调一致。然后，我们将这些系统的共同代数语义核心与其架构特定的功能组织区分开来，允许同一抽象系统类型的不同数学实现和机械实现。该框架应用于注意力头和残差连接，提供的语义解释仅依赖于共享的代数语义核心及其局部功能组织，因此可以超越标准Transformer进行泛化。这些分析还揭示了框架的模块性：复杂架构可以分解为更简单的语义协调子系统，这些子系统的组织可以在不同的抽象系统类型中重复出现。

articles.title: Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams
articles.abstract: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.
articles.titleCn: 事件-SAMA：基于语言的神经形态事件流视频对象分割
articles.abstractCn: 事件相机提供微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围且无运动模糊，但视频对象分割（RVOS）缺乏事件流数据集和模型。我们引入Event-SAMA-239K，这是SAMA-239K基础视频聊天语料库及所有附加SAMA训练数据的合成事件转换：包含30,650个视频片段和392,162张图像。通过光流、FILM或扫视上采样，再接线性事件生成器，可保留所有掩码、指代表达和对话标注。我们还引入Event-SAMA，通过双通道极性补丁嵌入（从预训练RGB权重初始化）和零初始化事件适配器对SAMA-4B进行适配。端到端训练在MeViS valid_u上达到24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$，在转换后的ReVOS valid子集上达到22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$，建立了首个事件原生RVOS基准（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS上为55.4）。冻结的RGB SAMA-4B通过伪RGB渲染或E2VID重建的相同事件，得分分别为13.23和15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$。无需重新训练时，Event-SAMA在事件密度匹配积累窗口时适用于真实事件相机录制。通过种子控制的消融实验，测量噪声底为0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$，发现除MeViS外，来自不同训练源的增益为+4.99，RGB均值事件干初始化为+4.33，可训练的SAM2掩码解码器为+2.76；事件适配器、部分ViT解冻和事件极性在此预算内噪声水平内。更早、部分转换的语料库快照使用相同配方训练，在MeViS上得分高1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$，在ReVOS上高1.12。两者均为单次运行，且训练周期长度不同，因此无法得出关于语料库规模的结论。

articles.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.
articles.titleCn: 通过强化学习激励大型语言模型的自我学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）利用参数化知识和检索增强生成（RAG）来处理知识密集型任务。然而，在陌生领域中的问题解决需要紧密耦合的知识获取和推理，而不仅仅是事实检索和聚合，或仅从预先组装的上下文中学习。我们研究自我学习——即实时自主检索、学习和应用长篇参考材料中的知识。为了研究这种能力，我们构建了一个基于教科书的数学问题解决任务。LLMs必须导航教科书内容，学习并应用相关原理，并为习题构建证明，同时不提供参考答案。我们引入了一个BookNavigator界面来支持这种受人类启发的学习过程，并通过具有细粒度奖励的强化学习（RL）激励自我学习。实验表明，我们的方法提高了跨领域和领域外教科书及科目的性能，将Intern-S2-Preview-35B的整体证明准确率从51.5%提高到79.5%，并优于RL训练的无教科书和固定检索基线。这些提升扩展到涉及不同任务类型的复杂长上下文基准，在BrowseComp-Plus和CL-bench上分别比基础模型提高了1.7和2.3个百分点。综合来看，这些发现表明RL可以促进领域无关的自我学习策略，突出了从长篇语料库中进行自我学习以增强复杂长上下文任务中更广泛问题解决能力的潜力。

articles.title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.
articles.titleCn: 评估视觉-语言模型中的文化知识编辑
articles.abstractCn: 当前的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在识别特定文化概念时常常失败，尤其是来自代表性不足地区的概念。将这种长尾知识有效地注入现有模型仍然是一个挑战。在这项工作中，我们通过引入CulturalBind来研究知识编辑作为一种有针对性的替代方案，CulturalBind是一个基准，包含来自6个领域的1K个概念的3.2K张图像，旨在评估具有文化感知能力的跨模态知识以及VLM中的概念级知识编辑。预编辑评估显示，文本知识和视觉知识是解耦的：模型通常表现出基于文本的文化概念知识，但无法从图像中识别它们。然后，我们在单次和序列场景中评估编辑方法。尽管当前方法成功地纠正了单个视觉识别错误，但它们表现出低跨模态可移植性，无法将编辑整合到模型的更广泛的参数知识中。此外，在序列编辑下性能迅速下降，突出了需要更全面的适应方法来更好地随时间整合多模态知识的必要性。

articles.title: Red-Teaming Large Language Models in Low-Resource African Languages: A Case Study of Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more widespread in Africa, their safety in low-resource languages remains largely untested since most red-teaming work focuses on English. This study evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs using 400 explicit adversarial prompts in Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, categorised into four harm categories. The responses were scored by native-speaker annotators and reliability was assessed using Cohen's $κ$. While models that rejected up to 69% of English prompts rejected as few as 0% in Yoruba, this was not because they were safer, but because they failed to understand the prompts. Attack success rates increased for most models in the Nigerian languages, with GPT-4o Mini demonstrating the most significant cross-lingual safety discrepancy (+0.23 in Yoruba). When models did engage with adversarial prompts, many of the responses were harmful, with rates of harmful content reaching 0.63 in English and 0.50 in Nigerian Pidgin. The most difficult harm category to detect was cultural stereotypes and discrimination (ASR = 0.44 in Nigerian Pidgin). Comprehension in Yoruba was low across most models, and this directly suppressed apparent attack success without indicating actual safety. Gemini 2.0 Flash was the most consistent model across languages. Despite its explicit training in African languages, Aya 101 had the highest attack success rate in English (0.60) and one of the lowest Yoruba comprehension rates (0.28). These results demonstrate that English-centric safety alignment does not transfer to Nigerian languages, highlighting the urgent need for language-specific safety evaluations.
articles.titleCn: 在低资源非洲语言中针对大型语言模型的红队测试：以约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语为例
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在非洲的普及，其在低资源语言中的安全性仍缺乏充分测试，因为大多数红队工作都集中在英语上。本研究使用400个在约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语中明确设计的对抗性提示（分为四类危害类别）评估了六种最先进的LLMs。响应由母语标注员评分，并使用Cohen's $κ$评估可靠性。虽然拒绝高达69%英语提示的模型在约鲁巴语中拒绝率最低（0%），但这并非因为它们更安全，而是因为它们无法理解提示。在尼日利亚语言中，大多数模型的攻击成功率有所提高，其中GPT-4o Mini显示出最显著的跨语言安全差异（约鲁巴语中+0.23）。当模型确实处理对抗性提示时，许多响应具有危害性，英语的危害内容率为0.63，尼日利亚皮钦语为0.50。最难检测的危害类别是文化刻板印象和歧视（尼日利亚皮钦语中ASR为0.44）。大多数模型在约鲁巴语中的理解能力较低，这直接抑制了明显的攻击成功率，并未表明实际安全性。Gemini 2.0 Flash是跨语言表现最一致的模型。尽管Aya 101接受了非洲语言的明确训练，但在英语中的攻击成功率最高（0.60），在约鲁巴语中的理解率最低（0.28）。这些结果表明，以英语为中心的安全校准并不能转移到尼日利亚语言中，突显了进行语言特定安全评估的紧迫性。

articles.title: Raincheck: Deferred Multimodal Prefill for Efficient Multi-Turn MLLM Inference
articles.abstract: Multi-turn conversations with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reuse input context, but long multimodal inputs increase time to first token (TTFT). Query-aware hard pruning reduces prefill tokens but permanently excludes information that later questions may require. We propose Raincheck, a framework for deferred multimodal prefill that decouples initial token selection from later information availability. An existing pruning method selects tokens for initial prefill; Raincheck preserves and progressively prefills unselected tokens in source order using unused compute capacity during decode. Unfinished prefill continues after answer return during available scheduling gaps. Attention visibility control and affine state mapping enable context updates after generation begins in full-attention and hybrid recurrent models. Prefill-decode fusion reduces repeated weight reads. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B with 30% initial multimodal-token retention. Across both models and four pruning methods, Raincheck recovers on average 77.7% and 60.4% of the quality lost to matched hard pruning on MultiVerse and ConvBench, respectively. On MultiVerse, the SGLang implementation reduces mean first-turn TTFT by up to 24.1% relative to full prefill, with less than 0.5% increase in mean time per output token (TPOT).
articles.titleCn: 雨检：高效多轮MLLM推理的延迟多模态预填充
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多轮对话会重用输入上下文，但长多模态输入会增加首次生成token的时间（TTFT）。查询感知的硬剪枝减少了预填充token数量，但永久排除了后续问题可能需要的信息。我们提出了Raincheck，一个用于延迟多模态预填充的框架，将初始token选择与后续信息可用性解耦。现有剪枝方法为初始预填充选择token；Raincheck保留未选择的token，并使用解码期间未使用的计算能力按源顺序逐步预填充，未完成的预填充在返回答案后继续进行可用调度间隙。注意力可见性控制和仿射状态映射使全注意力模型和混合循环模型在生成开始后能够更新上下文。预填充-解码融合减少了重复的权重读取。我们对Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3.5-9B进行评估，初始多模态token保留率为30%。在MultiVerse和ConvBench上，Raincheck分别平均恢复了与匹配硬剪枝损失的质量的77.7%和60.4%。在MultiVerse上，SGLang实现相对于全预填充将平均首次轮次的TTFT降低了高达24.1%，且输出token平均时间（TPOT）增加不到0.5%。

articles.title: Lost in the Latent Space: How Code Embeddings Represent Functional Intent and Implementation Fidelity
articles.abstract: Code embedding models have become a key building block for many software engineering applications, yet their internal representations remain poorly understood. Existing evaluations tend to focus on downstream task performance, offering limited insight into whether a single embedding can support both functional abstraction and implementation-sensitive analysis. To address this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of 14 state-of-the-art code embedding models. We evaluate their representational behavior through three complementary analyses: supervised probing for functional abstraction and implementation fidelity, zero-shot retrieval experiments to assess geometric similarity, and controlled perturbation experiments that measure embedding responses to semantics-preserving code transformations. The results reveal a consistent abstraction-fidelity tension: models that better preserve stylistic and structural signals tend to do so at the expense of semantic generalization, while models with similar retrieval performance can nevertheless respond very differently to the same implementation changes. Overall, our findings suggest that a single universal code representation remains out of reach, motivating more representation-aware evaluation, selection, and deployment of code embedding models in software engineering.
articles.titleCn: 迷失在潜在空间中：代码嵌入如何表征功能意图和实现保真度
articles.abstractCn: 代码嵌入模型已成为许多软件工程应用的关键构建模块，但它们的内部表示仍然缺乏理解。现有的评估往往侧重于下游任务性能，仅能提供有限的见解，无法判断单个嵌入是否既能支持功能抽象，又能进行与实现相关的分析。为填补这一空白，我们针对14种最先进的代码嵌入模型进行了大规模实证研究。我们通过三种互补的分析方法评估其表示行为：用于功能抽象和实现保真度的监督探测、用于评估几何相似度的零样本检索实验，以及用于测量嵌入对语义保持代码转换响应的控制扰动实验。结果表明，存在一种持续抽象-保真度之间的矛盾：那些更好地保留风格和结构信号的模型往往以牺牲语义泛化能力为代价，而检索性能相似的模型则可能对相同的实现变更做出截然不同的响应。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，单一通用的代码表示仍然难以实现，这促使我们在软件工程中进行更具表示感知的代码嵌入模型的评估、选择和部署。

articles.title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
articles.abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.
articles.titleCn: 在语言空间中整合异构超声心动图AI输出：具有监督LLM的可学习后期融合
articles.abstractCn: 视图和目标特异性超声心动图AI模型捕捉有用但互补的信息，单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习型集成是结合这些输出的自然方式，但异构模型通常需要将每个输出转换为二元决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度特征向量。我们开发了一种基于监督大型语言模型（LLM）的后期融合模块，该模块直接在语言空间中聚合视图特定的预测发现声明和预测测量值，并学习案例级别的融合函数。在对646名患者的859次检查进行患者级别的三折交叉验证中，所提出的方法在一个框架内整合了异构输出，其性能与评估的最佳参考策略相当，并且优于未经任务特定训练的通用LLM。这些结果表明，监督LLM可以在不需要模型特定输出转换或需要医学知识的特征工程的情况下，结合多个上游模型。

articles.title: ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation
articles.abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports describe adversary behavior in natural language, but converting them into structured MITRE ATT&CK mappings remains difficult: existing methods decompose reports to sentence-level granularity for extraction, while modern LLMs can work with full reports in a single pass but with noticeable performance degradation. We present ARBITRA, which orchestrates multiple role-specialized LLM experts that propose candidate ATT&CK entities from the full report, which are then verified through a per-candidate quantitative bipolar argumentation framework (QBAF) grounded in document evidence and rationales. We additionally construct reasoning-specialized corpora for fine-tuning so experts can act as effective participants during this verification process. Across ATT&CK extraction benchmarks, ARBITRA reaches a stronger precision-oriented operating point than sentence-level pipelines, recent LLM-based extraction systems, and frontier models including GPT-5.5. Under adversarial perturbations simulating conflicting TTP statements, cross-report contamination, and semantic poisoning, ARBITRA limits mean precision degradation to roughly half that of frontier-model baselines for a more robust extraction.
