articles.titleCn: ARBITRA：基于多专家论证的鲁棒文档级ATT&CK提取
articles.abstractCn: 网络威胁情报（CTI）报告以自然语言描述对手行为，但将其转换为结构化的MITRE ATT&CK映射仍然存在困难：现有方法将报告分解为句子级别的粒度进行提取，而现代大型语言模型（LLM）虽然能一次性处理完整报告，但性能明显下降。我们提出了ARBITRA，该系统协调多个角色专业化的LLM专家，从完整报告中提出候选ATT&CK实体，然后通过基于文档证据和推理的每项候选定量双极论证框架（QBAF）进行验证。此外，我们构建了推理专业化的语料库进行微调，以便专家在验证过程中能作为有效参与者。在ATT&CK提取基准测试中，ARBITRA达到的精度导向操作点强于句子级别管道、基于LLM的提取系统和包括GPT-5.5在内的前沿模型。在模拟冲突战术技术（TTP）声明、跨报告污染和语义中毒的对抗性扰动下，ARBITRA将平均精度下降限制在约前沿模型基线的一半，实现了更鲁棒的提取。

articles.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 诊断参考差距：视觉支架在多模态推理中能做什么与不能做什么
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型能够识别视觉内容，但在多步骤推理时难以可靠地处理这些内容。在计数任务中，模型可能看到所有物体，但会忘记已经数过哪些。我们认为，这类错误通常被归因于感知能力，实际上揭示了参照差距问题：即模型未能将语言与相关的视觉实体、区域或位置进行绑定。基于视觉程序理论，我们检验了外部参照（如编号）是否能够缩小这一差距。我们引入了ReGap-Bench，这是一个包含五个视觉推理任务的配对基准，其中场景、问题和答案均固定不变，仅参照方式有所变化。结果表明，与任务匹配的参照能将准确率提高高达25%，而与任务不匹配的参照则几乎无益，甚至可能损害性能。这些发现将参照差距识别为与视觉感知不同的瓶颈，并表明构建任务相关的视觉参照可以作为一种无需训练的视觉技能，用于提升多模态推理能力。

articles.title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.
articles.titleCn: 精心指定与充分测试？使用自进化代理评估SWE-bench风格数据集
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程（SE）任务上表现出色，推动了高质量数据集的需求，以进行可靠的训练和评估。SWE-bench风格的（SWE）数据集被广泛用于评估基于LLM的编码代理在现实世界软件问题上的表现，其中任务清晰度和测试覆盖率直接影响实例的可解决性和可验证性。然而，现有SWE数据集仍存在质量问题，手动标注成本高昂且工作量大，这促使了基于LLM的标注方法。现有方法通常依赖于静态、过于笼统的评分标准，限制了它们处理多样化和细微场景的能力，并常常导致高误报率。相比之下，人工标注者借鉴积累的经验进行情境感知的判断。受此启发，我们提出了ExLabel，一个基于LLM的自进化、经验指导的助手，用于评估SWE数据集中的任务清晰度和测试覆盖率。ExLabel维护一个不断发展的经验库，将跨实例知识提炼成稳定且自适应的判断标准，并重用相关经验来指导新实例的评估。为进行系统性评估，我们通过清理SWE-bench和Multi-SWE-bench的人工标注，构建了跨越八种编程语言的SWE-TQ新基准。使用三种核心LLM进行的实验表明，ExLabel在所有设置中均实现了最佳的F1分数，在Python/多语言子集上对任务清晰度和测试覆盖率评估分别比最佳基线提高了44.2%/49.9%和24.0%/18.4%。此外，一个在由ExLabel过滤的SWE-rebench数据上微调的编码模型解决了SWE-bench Verified上的66.2%的问题，优于在最佳基线过滤数据上训练的模型，提高了14.5%。

articles.title: How Specific Do I Need to Be? Effects of User Query Underspecification on Deep Research Agents
articles.abstract: Deep research agents (DRAs) conduct long-horizon reasoning, search, and literature synthesis to provide long-form answers to complex, domain-specific questions. These agents are typically trained and evaluated on fully specified user queries. However, real-world user queries can often be underspecified. We introduce UNDERSPEC-DR, a framework for systematically evaluating how underspecified queries affect agents' final answer quality and intermediate search behavior. Across three DRAs we evaluated, underspecification substantially reduces how well DRA's answers fulfill users' information needs, even though they remain grounded in cited evidence. Our analysis of intermediate search behavior suggests a possible explanation: DRAs conduct broader searches that draw less on the original user query but rely more on their learned prior during training, which can be misaligned with users' intent. Our findings reveal the vulnerability of current DRAs to underspecified user queries and inform future efforts to build DRAs that proactively recognize when additional user input is needed to reliably complete deep research tasks.
articles.titleCn: 我需要具体到什么程度？用户查询欠指定对深度研究代理的影响
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理（DRAs）进行长时程推理、搜索和文献综合，以针对复杂、特定领域的长尾问题提供长篇答案。这些代理通常在完全指定的用户查询上进行训练和评估。然而，现实中的用户查询往往是不明确的。我们引入UNDERSPEC-DR框架，系统性地评估不明确查询如何影响代理最终答案质量和中间搜索行为。在评估的三个DRAs中，不明确性显著降低了DRAs答案满足用户信息需求的程度，尽管它们仍然基于引用的证据。我们对中间搜索行为的分析提出了可能的解释：DRAs进行更广泛的搜索，较少依赖原始用户查询，而更多地依赖训练时学习到的先验知识，这可能与用户意图不一致。我们的研究揭示了当前DRAs对不明确用户查询的脆弱性，并为未来构建能够主动识别何时需要用户补充输入以可靠完成深度研究任务的DRAs提供了启示。

articles.title: Robustness of Chatbot LLM Judgments of Presidential Actions and Hypothetical Reforms
articles.abstract: Chatbots are increasingly consulted about public affairs, and their judgments of policies are useful only if they are robust. We measure this robustness in the setting of an ordinary user, through consumer chat interfaces. For 30 days, five chatbot configurations (Mistral, Gemini Flash, Claude Sonnet, and Claude Opus at two effort settings) were asked twice a day to score the long-term effect on the United States of 40 actions of the last four presidential administrations and of 15 hypothetical reforms, each with a confidence and a short comment. The judgments are robust: all configurations agree on the sign and the ranking of the administrations' mean scores, and two different configurations asked on the same day give opposite signs to the same action in about 4% of cases. Responses from different days differ more than same-day responses, but the difference grows slowly over the month, except where the service itself changed. We identify three such changes, which shifted the judgments while leaving little or no trace in the interface. Treating the comments as a retrieval task, we find them specific to each item and consistent across runs and chatbots, with lexical and embedding similarities agreeing. We release the dataset of 16,500 judgments.
articles.titleCn: 聊天机器人LLM对总统行为和假设性改革的判断的鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 聊天机器人在公共事务方面的咨询日益增多，而它们的政策判断只有在稳健的情况下才具有价值。我们在普通用户场景下，通过消费者聊天界面来衡量这种稳健性。在30天内，五种聊天机器人配置（Mistral、Gemini Flash、Claude Sonnet以及Claude Opus在两种努力设置下）每天被询问两次，要求对过去四届总统政府采取的40项行动以及15项假设性改革产生长期影响进行评分，每项评分都附带置信度和简短评论。这些判断是稳健的：所有配置都同意行政当局平均分数的正负号和排名，而在同一天询问的两个不同配置大约有4%的情况下对同一行动给出相反的正负号。不同日期的响应差异大于同一天内的响应差异，但差异在一个月内缓慢增长，除非服务本身发生了变化。我们识别出三种此类变化，这些变化改变了判断，但在界面中几乎没有或没有痕迹。我们将评论视为检索任务，发现它们针对每个项目都是特定的，并且在多次运行和不同聊天机器人之间保持一致，词汇和嵌入相似性也相互吻合。我们发布了包含16500个判断的数据集。

articles.title: What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty
articles.abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. Retrieval of knowledge that could not be derived from the stem was particularly prominent in the PANCE rubrics, whereas the USMLE rubrics placed greater emphasis on integrating multiple clinical cues. We compared commercial and open-weight LLMs on held-out items under unguided and rubric-guided conditions. Rubric guidance changed how models used the difficulty scale but did not consistently improve performance. In absolute judgments, guidance encouraged broader use of the scale and generally improved coarse-grained agreement, without consistently improving rank ordering. In pairwise comparisons, its effects varied across models and examinations, and judgments became more sensitive to presentation order. These findings suggest that the value of label-guided rubric induction may lie more in generating interpretable, testable hypotheses from empirical difficulty data than in reliably improving difficulty judgments.
articles.titleCn: 是什么让医学检查项目变得困难？使用大型语言模型探索与经验项目难度相关的模式
articles.abstractCn: 对医疗项目难度的研究主要集中于预测而非识别与经验难度相关的可解释模式。本研究利用经验难度标签引导大型语言模型（LLM）诱导难度标准，并考察了标准引导如何影响LLM的难度判断。研究使用美国医师执照考试（USMLE）和医师助理国家认证考试（PANCE）的训练项目及其经验难度估计，Claude Opus 5分别对绝对难度和成对难度判断诱导了不同的标准。所诱导的标准均未将表面特征（如题干长度、选项数量或图像）视为主要难度来源。在两项考试中均出现了一些模式，包括线索趋同、误导性线索和选项竞争，尽管其具体形式有所不同。从题干中无法推导出的知识检索在PANCE标准中尤为突出，而USMLE标准更强调整合多个临床线索。我们在无引导和标准引导条件下，对商业型和开放权重LLM在保留项目上的表现进行了比较。标准引导改变了模型使用难度量表的方式，但并未始终提升性能。在绝对判断中，引导鼓励更广泛地使用量表，并通常提高了粗粒度一致性，但并未始终改善排序。在成对比较中，其效果因模型和考试而异，且判断对呈现顺序变得更加敏感。这些发现表明，标签引导的标准诱导的价值可能更多地在于从经验难度数据中生成可解释、可检验的假设，而非可靠地提升难度判断。

articles.title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.
articles.titleCn: 置信度锚定顺序残差解码：用于掩码扩散语言模型的Cord
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的解码顺序会显著影响生成质量，但常见的解码器通常在整个生成过程中应用相同的揭示规则。置信度提供了一个强大的默认值，但它衡量的是当前如何果断地预测某个位置，而不是揭示该位置对后续解码有多大帮助。我们提出了Cord，一种轻量级的提示条件策略，它将置信度解码作为稳定参考，并通过生成方向上的几何残差、与已揭示上下文的接近程度以及双向填充来学习何时以及如何偏离它。残差会适应提示以及不断变化的局部响应。Cord不是在每一步解码时采样新的策略动作，而是在每个回滚中采样一个低维系数矩阵，从而诱导出一个整个状态相关的揭示轨迹。这产生了一种上下文老虎机公式，直接从序列级奖励中进行训练，无需步骤级归因或主干更新。在三个dLLMs和五个推理、代码和约束满足基准测试中，Cord将平均任务成功率从置信度解码的32.0%提高到48.2%，并且进一步超过了每个领域的最佳固定残差。行为审计表明，学习的残差在揭示局部性和双向填充方面引起了大量与任务相关的变化。Cord仅增加了0.53M可训练参数，无需额外的主干前向传递，并且推理延迟开销仅为5.39%。

articles.title: Does the Citation Matter? Quality, Grounding, and Physician-Rubric Accuracy of Google's AI Overviews for Medical Information
articles.abstract: Google's AI Overviews (AIOs) are the first result users encounter when searching the web, shifting the work of selecting and evaluating sources from the user to Gemini. This may be especially consequential for health information, given that Google's traditional algorithm was designed to prioritize quality sources, and inaccurate information carries health risks. We evaluated 3,611 benchmark health questions, comparing each AIO against that question's top five traditional results on source selection and quality. We also evaluated the AIOs' statement grounding in their cited sources and how accurate AIOs were against physician-written rubrics. Overviews appeared for 96.4% of questions but drew on substantially different evidence than traditional search: only 44.4% of the top five results were cited by the corresponding AIO, which instead overrepresented commercial health publishers (e.g., WebMD, Healthline) at the expense of academic and government sources (e.g., Cleveland Clinic, National Health Service). AIO-cited pages scored lower than traditional results on four of six well-established credibility criteria. The grounding of AIO statements to their sources was poor: after correcting for classifier error, an estimated 56.7% of cited statements were supported by their cited page, and a further 20.8% of all statements were factual claims with no citation at all. When AIOs were graded against physicians' rubrics, they earned 38.2% of all available points (e.g., accuracy 54.2%, completeness 21.6%), and among the subset of AIOs whose physician rubric anticipated a specific inaccurate or potentially harmful claim, 22.2% of AIOs contained the harmful content. Notably, the accuracy of AIOs was unrelated to the grounding of their statements. We recommend AIO literacy interventions for users and holding AIOs at least to Google's own health-ranking standards.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SamAgnoli/AIOverviews
articles.titleCn: 引用重要吗？质量、基础和医生标准准确性——谷歌医疗信息AI概览
articles.abstractCn: 谷歌的AI概览（AIOs）是用户在网络上搜索时遇到的首个结果，将选择和评估信息来源的工作从用户转移到了Gemini。考虑到谷歌传统算法旨在优先考虑高质量来源，而错误信息可能带来健康风险，这一点对于健康信息领域尤其重要。我们对3,611个基准健康问题进行了评估，比较了每个AIO与该问题传统搜索排名前五的结果在信息来源选择和质量上的表现。我们还评估了AIOs对其引用来源的陈述依据情况，以及AIOs与医师编写的评估标准的准确性。概览出现在96.4%的问题中，但与传统搜索所依赖的证据差异很大：只有44.4%的前五名结果被相应的AIO引用，而AIO却过度代表了商业健康发布商（如WebMD、Healthline），牺牲了学术和政府来源（如克利夫兰诊所、国家医疗服务体系）。AIO引用的页面在六个公认的信誉标准中的四个上得分低于传统结果。AIO陈述对其来源的依据情况不佳：在修正分类器错误后，估计有56.7%的引用陈述得到了其引用页面的支持，另外还有20.8%的所有陈述完全没有引用。当根据医师的评估标准对AIO进行评分时，它们获得了所有可用分数的38.2%（例如，准确性54.2%，完整性21.6%），而在那些医师评估标准预期包含特定不准确或潜在有害声明的AIO子集中，有22.2%的AIO包含了有害内容。值得注意的是，AIO的准确性与其陈述的依据情况无关。我们建议为用户提供AIO素养干预措施，并要求AIO至少达到谷歌自身的健康排名标准。

articles.title: Unlimited OCR Works 2
articles.abstract: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. By combining SR-SWA with Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm, Unlimited OCR 2 enables document parsing over virtually unlimited lengths without prohibitive memory overhead. At the hundred-page scale, Unlimited OCR 2 achieves 7.0$\times$ and 5.6$\times$ per-step speedups over Full Attention and R-SWA, respectively. Furthermore, it delivers state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on both MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, our newly proposed benchmark targeting hundred-page document parsing. Ultimately, the capacity for uninterrupted, one-shot document parsing signifies a fundamental paradigm shift into the OCR 3.0 era.
articles.titleCn: 无限OCR工作2
articles.abstractCn: 无限OCR开启了长时序解析的时代，显著缓解了随着文档长度增长而增加的工作记忆负担。然而，当文档长度扩展到数百页时，视觉上下文会大幅增长，急剧提高每一步解码的计算成本，限制了超长文档解析的可扩展性。受人类通过局部聚焦转录书籍而不重新扫描前几页的启发，我们推出了无限OCR 2，这是一种仅关注其转录内容的文档解析模型。基于无限OCR，我们将所有解码器注意力模块升级为稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力（SR-SWA），将活跃参考标记限制在固定容量内，从而在任意长度的文档上保持恒定的计算成本。通过结合SR-SWA与无限时序解码范式，无限OCR 2实现了对几乎无限长度文档的解析，而不会带来过高的内存开销。在百页规模下，无限OCR 2分别比全注意力机制和R-SWA实现了每步7.0倍和5.6倍的加速。此外，它在我们的新提出的基准MPDocBench和MarathonDocBench（针对百页文档解析的基准）上均达到了最先进的端到端性能。最终，不间断、一次性文档解析的能力标志着OCR 3.0时代的根本范式转变。

articles.title: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning with Evidence-Ablated Negatives
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful tool for improving multimodal reasoning. However, standard outcome supervision suffers from credit assignment ambiguity, as a model may receive positive rewards by exploiting language priors or dataset shortcuts rather than grounding its reasoning in the requisite visual evidence. This makes high-quality negative responses critical, since effective negatives should remain plausible under the current policy while exposing the shortcut that should be suppressed. In this paper, we propose EVAN, a multimodal reinforcement learning framework utilizing EVidence-Ablated Negatives to train LMMs against their own language-prior failures. EVAN first identifies highly visually dependent examples using a scaled image information gain metric and preserves data diversity with a mixed-ranking strategy. It then constructs evidence-ablated images by masking the most discriminative image patches, eliciting plausible but visually ungrounded responses from the current policy. During policy optimization, these negative responses are incorporated as bounded auxiliary signals under the clean image, penalizing shortcut learning while maintaining RL stability. Experiments across challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EVAN mitigates modality imbalance and improves over strong RLVR baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git.
articles.titleCn: 基于证据删除的负例对多模态推理进行基础化
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升多模态推理能力的有力工具。然而，标准结果监督存在归因模糊问题，因为模型可能通过利用语言先验或数据集捷径获得正向奖励，而非基于必要的视觉证据进行推理。这使得高质量负样本变得至关重要，因为有效的负样本应在当前策略下保持合理性，同时暴露需要抑制的捷径。在本文中，我们提出了EVAN，一个利用证据移除负样本的多模态强化学习框架，用于训练语言模型（LMM）以对抗其自身的语言先验失效。EVAN首先使用缩放图像信息增益指标识别高度依赖视觉的样本，并通过混合排序策略保留数据多样性。然后，通过遮盖最具判别性的图像块构建证据移除图像，从而引出当前策略下看似合理但缺乏视觉基础的响应。在策略优化过程中，这些负样本被作为有界辅助信号在干净图像下引入，惩罚捷径学习的同时保持RL稳定性。在具有挑战性的多模态推理基准测试中的实验表明，EVAN缓解了模态不平衡问题，并优于强大的RLVR基线。我们的代码可在https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git获取。

articles.title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating complex information-seeking and transactional tasks across the open web. However, their real-world reliability remains limited by access barriers, such as dead links, authentication walls, rate limits, and anti-scraping defenses. These barriers block the primary execution path, causing agents to abort prematurely, loop indefinitely, or quietly compromise the user's original constraints. Existing evaluations either implicitly assume that target resources are freely accessible or focus on transient perturbations that simple retries can resolve, failing to capture scenarios where agents must actively reroute around impassable bottlenecks. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces AgentHeal, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating goal-preserving resource recovery, defined as the ability of web agents to detect non-transient access barriers, pivot to legitimate alternative sources, and fulfill the user's exact original objective. Spanning nine barrier families across a counterfactual sandbox and real-website replay, our experiments on leading LLM backbones show that average task success drops sharply from 89.4% to 43.7% under access barriers. Further analysis reveals that agents frequently fall for deceptive look-alikes, fail to escalate to users when necessary, violate access policies, or waste computation on futile retries, providing actionable diagnostics for developing resilient web agents.
articles.comment: Code and Dataset are available at https://github.com/Lzzzzzzzzzzy/AgentHeal
articles.titleCn: AgentHeal：评估在访问障碍下网络代理的目标保持资源恢复能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在自动化开放网络上的复杂信息搜索和交易任务方面展现出强大能力。然而，其现实中的可靠性受限于访问障碍，如死链、认证壁垒、速率限制和反爬虫防御。这些障碍会阻断主要执行路径，导致代理过早中止、无限循环或暗中违背用户的原始约束。现有评估要么隐含假设目标资源可以自由访问，要么关注简单重试即可解决的瞬时扰动，未能捕捉代理必须主动绕过不可逾越的瓶颈的场景。为弥补这一差距，本文介绍了AgentHeal，这是一个综合基准，用于评估目标保留的资源恢复能力，即网络代理检测非瞬时访问障碍、转向合法替代来源并实现用户原始目标的能力。在反事实沙盒和真实网站重放中涵盖九类障碍，我们对主流LLM主干网络的实验表明，在访问障碍下，平均任务成功率从89.4%急剧下降至43.7%。进一步分析揭示，代理常被伪装的欺骗性内容所迷惑，在必要时未能升级通知用户，违反访问策略，或在徒劳的重试上浪费计算资源，为开发弹性网络代理提供了可操作的诊断依据。

articles.title: XLaw-JP-27B: A Lightweight Open Model Specialized for Japanese Law
articles.abstract: We present XLaw-JP-27B, an open-weight model specialized for Japanese law that runs on a single 48\,GB GPU under the Apache~2.0 licence. It adapts Qwen3.8-27B with hybrid retrieval over all current statutes and 31k case summaries, a light QLoRA fine-tune on its own verified answers to past bar-exam questions (self-distillation), a contract-specific LoRA adapter, and four-sample voting. We evaluate it on eight Japanese legal tasks---the multiple-choice section of the bar examination in 2024, 2025 and 2026, statement-level bar questions (JBE-QA), statute questions (LawQA-JP), the patent attorney exam, and contract review and drafting built from government model contracts---against open models of 12--33B under identical prompts and retrieval. XLaw-JP-27B ranks first on six tasks, ties on one and is third on one (mean rank 1.3 against 2.8--3.1 for the baselines). It is the only system that passes the bar exam in all three years (129, 120 and 130 of 175, meeting every subject minimum; no test-year material was used in training), while open Japanese 32--33B models fail at least one year. A controlled study of each component shows that retrieval, voting and self-distillation help, and that thinking mode, retrieval-grounded synthetic tuning, self-verification, per-statement decomposition and more self-distillation do not. The largest remaining gaps to frontier models are in contract review and patent law. The model is available as a free web service at https://x-law.jp/ with the weights available at https://huggingface.co/X-LawJapan/xlaw-jp-27b under Apache~2.0.
articles.titleCn: XLaw-JP-27B：一个专为日本法律设计的轻量级开放模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了XLaw-JP-27B，一个专门针对日本法律的开放权重模型，该模型在单个48GB GPU上运行，并遵循Apache~2.0许可证。它基于Qwen3.8-27B进行改进，通过混合检索覆盖所有现行法规和31,000份案例摘要，对自身验证的过去律师资格考试答案进行轻量级QLoRA微调（自我蒸馏），采用特定合同的LoRA适配器，以及四样本投票。我们在八个日本法律任务上评估了该模型——2024年、2025年和2026年的律师资格考试选择题部分，声明级律师问题（JBE-QA），法规问题（LawQA-JP），专利律师考试，以及基于政府标准合同构建的合同审查和起草——与12-33B的开放模型在相同提示和检索条件下进行对比。XLaw-JP-27B在六个任务中排名第一，一个任务中并列第一，一个任务中排名第三（平均排名1.3，而基线模型的平均排名为2.8-3.1）。它是唯一在三年中都通过律师资格考试的系统（129、120和130个中的175个，满足所有科目最低要求；训练中未使用任何测试年材料），而开放式的日本32-33B模型至少有一年未通过。对每个组件的受控研究表明，检索、投票和自我蒸馏有帮助，而思维模式、基于检索的综合微调、自我验证、逐声明分解和更多自我蒸馏则没有帮助。与前沿模型最大的差距仍然存在于合同审查和专利法领域。该模型作为免费网络服务提供在https://x-law.jp/，权重可在https://huggingface.co/X-LawJapan/xlaw-jp-27b上以Apache~2.0许可证获取。

articles.title: Reasoning or Pattern Exploitation? Mechanistic Insights from RL-Trained Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly described as acquiring "reasoning" skills after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, whether these gains reflect genuine reasoning or more superficial adaptations remains underexplored. In this work, we probe LLMs trained in a finite and exhaustively analyzable logical domain, namely Tic-Tac-Toe, and trace how internal representations evolve across reinforcement learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Quantitatively, RL yields high accuracy and robustness across prompt variations, suggesting the emergence of game reasoning. Mechanistic interpretability, however, paints a different picture: features extracted with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal that models primarily adapt to rely more heavily on information already explicit in the prompt, such as whose turn it is, game progression and board occupancy. In comparison, high-level concepts like board symmetries and strategic forks remain weakly represented, raising concerns that reasoning benchmarks overestimate model abilities. This suggests that RL-driven "reasoning" may conflate task-specific adaptations to input information with reasoning ability. We provide, for the first time: (i) a systematic interpretability pipeline tracing representation dynamics across RL training in small-scale LLMs; (ii) an extension of SAE-based feature discovery to hypothesis-driven testing in a finite logical domain; and (iii) an interpretability-based demonstration that RL post-training neither adds nor removes concept information but reorganizes which features dominate the representation, with causal interventions locating the decision downstream of it, in the late-layer state.
articles.titleCn: 推理还是模式利用？来自强化学习训练语言模型的机制洞察
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在经过带可验证奖励的强化学习后，越来越多地被描述为获得了“推理”能力。然而，这些进步是否反映了真正的推理能力，还是更表面的适应能力，仍有待深入探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了在有限且可完全分析的逻辑领域（即井字棋）中训练的LLMs，并追踪了在群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习过程中内部表征的演变。定量分析表明，强化学习在提示变化下能产生高准确性和鲁棒性，这表明游戏推理能力正在涌现。然而，机制可解释性描绘了另一幅图景：稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）提取的特征显示，模型主要适应了更依赖提示中已明确的信息，例如轮到谁、游戏进程和棋盘占用情况。相比之下，高级概念如棋盘对称性和策略性分叉则表示较弱，这引发了推理基准可能高估模型能力的担忧。这表明，由强化学习驱动的“推理”可能将特定任务的输入信息适应与推理能力混淆。我们首次提供了：(i) 一个系统性的可解释性流程，追踪小规模LLMs在强化学习训练过程中的表征动态；(ii) 将基于SAEs的特征发现扩展到有限逻辑领域的假设驱动测试；(iii) 基于可解释性的证明，即强化学习后训练既不增加也不移除概念信息，而是重新组织了主导表征的特征，因果干预定位了决策在下游的晚期层状态。

articles.title: Reading-Level Verification of Kanji Words in Japanese Financial Speech Synthesis
articles.abstract: Few-shot voice cloning makes it cheap to produce daily Japanese financial commentary with several synthetic speakers, but kanji words with more than one reading, such as the word for "market" (shijo vs. ichiba) or "overall trend" (taisei vs. oze), are still misread. A common quality gate transcribes each synthesized sentence with automatic speech recognition (ASR), converts both the input and the transcript to kana, and regenerates on mismatch. We show that this gate is unreliable in both directions: when the audio contains a misreading, the ASR language model frequently writes the expected kanji back, hiding the error, and when the audio is correct, ordinary recognition errors trigger needless regeneration. We propose a reading-level check that scores the expected reading and its confusable alternatives with a connectionist temporal classification (CTC) hiragana recognizer and flags a word when an alternative explains the audio better. On 540 utterances from three voice-cloned production voices covering 30 financial terms, with misreadings injected under controlled conditions, the transcript-based gate detected 78.9% of misreadings at a 44.4% false-alarm rate, whereas the proposed check detected 91.7% at 5.0% (AUC 0.990). On natural kanji input, it caught a front-end error that the transcript-based gate missed for one voice, and reduced regeneration requests from 38.9% to 6.1% of sentences.
articles.titleCn: 日语金融语音合成中汉字词的阅读水平验证
articles.abstractCn: 小样本语音克隆技术使得使用多个合成语音生成日常日语财经评论变得经济可行，但具有多种读音的汉字词（如“市场”的“shijo”与“ichiba”或“整体趋势”的“taisei”与“oze”）仍然会被误读。一种常见的质量关卡通过自动语音识别（ASR）转录每句合成语音，将输入和转录结果都转换为假名，并在出现不匹配时重新生成。我们证明这个关卡在两个方向上都不可靠：当音频包含误读时，ASR语言模型经常将预期的汉字写回去，掩盖了错误；而当音频正确时，普通识别错误会触发不必要的重新生成。我们提出了一种读音级别的检查，使用连接时序分类（CTC）假名识别器对预期的读音及其易混淆的替代读音进行评分，并在某个替代读音能更好地解释音频时标记该词。在三个语音克隆生产语音覆盖30个财经术语的540个语句中，受控条件下注入误读，基于转录的关卡检测到78.9%的误读，但错误警报率为44.4%，而提出的检查检测到91.7%，错误警报率为5.0%（AUC 0.990）。在自然汉字输入中，它捕获了一个基于转录的关卡错过的前端错误，并将重新生成请求从38.9%的语句减少到6.1%。

articles.title: A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction
articles.abstract: In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.
articles.comment: Extended version of the AAAI 2026 paper, including the technical appendix. 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/akshay25vyas/invariants-metric-eval
articles.titleCn: 一种评估多输出结构化预测评估指标的新方法
articles.abstractCn: 在多输出结构化预测任务中，尽管训练数据中可能只提供一个真实标签，但可能存在多个同样有效的输出，这使得可靠的评估成为一个持续的挑战。我们假设人类评估者会隐式地使用特定任务的内在属性，例如彩色图像中的对象边界或翻译中的命名实体，来判断一个输出是否可接受。基于这一假设，我们引入了近似任务内在属性的概念，并将其作为诊断工具来评估视觉和语言任务中现有的多种指标。我们使用这些任务内在属性作为框架的一部分，通过增强损失函数鼓励模型输出中包含领域相关的内在属性，从而系统地测试指标的可靠性。在我们的实验中，我们发现通过增强损失函数强制执行内在属性，可以显著提高流行分布式指标的性能，而更传统的指标仅发生微小变化。通过这种内在属性驱动的评估，我们揭示了标准指标无法检测到有意义差异的地方，并强调了分布式指标成功或仍然不足的条件。

articles.title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
articles.abstract: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality. To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents. HALO-Arena covers 4 proactive need types, Dependency, Blockage, Risk, and Opportunity, across 10 everyday domains and 50 personal environments. Scenarios require agents to retrieve evidence from structured databases or unstructured documents before judging whether assistance is warranted and choosing its scope. On HALO-Arena, we construct HALO-8K, a dataset of 8,000 responses from 10 models across 400 scenarios, annotated by 20 experts for action level, acceptability verdicts, and human diagnosis. For rejected responses, human diagnosis covers timing, intensity, and other issues. Recorded reasoning tokens and retrieval rounds measure the effort behind these responses. The best proprietary and open-source models achieve 72.88% and 56.63% acceptability, respectively. Our central finding is that over-proactivity is the dominant observed failure mode, with Premature timing or Excessive intensity accounting for 61.20% of rejected responses. Further analyses yield complementary findings on the balance between intervention and restraint, evidence acquisition, and the calibration of timing and intensity.
articles.titleCn: HALO：人类基准粒度评估主动代理
articles.abstractCn: 主动代理必须在未收到明确请求的情况下决定何时以及如何提供帮助。现有的评估方法通常依赖于自动评分或二元判定，对证据使用和干预质量的诊断能力有限。为解决这些不足，我们引入了HALO（人类指导的粒度化主动代理评估），其评估场景（HALO-Arena）涵盖了4种主动需求类型（依赖、阻塞、风险和机会），涉及10个日常领域和50个个人环境。在这些场景中，代理需要从结构化数据库或非结构化文档中检索证据，然后判断是否需要提供帮助并选择其范围。在HALO-Arena平台上，我们构建了HALO-8K数据集，包含来自10个模型在400个场景中的8000个响应，由20位专家标注了行动级别、可接受性判定和人类诊断。对于被拒绝的响应，人类诊断涵盖了时机、强度及其他问题。记录的推理标记和检索轮次衡量了这些响应背后的努力。最佳的专有和开源模型分别达到了72.88%和56.63%的可接受性。我们的核心发现是过度主动性是主要的观察到的失效模式，其中时机过早或强度过大会导致61.20%的响应被拒绝。进一步分析揭示了干预与克制之间的平衡、证据获取以及时机和强度校准等方面的补充发现。
